Remote CCTV Monitoring Specialist



We are hiring a dependable Remote CCTV Monitoring Specialist to provide live overnight surveillance of a commercial property located in Santa Fe Springs, California.



Schedule: 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM Pacific Time (California)

Starting Pay: $2.50 USD per hour

Performance Review: After 90 days

* Actively monitor live CCTV cameras throughout the entire shift.

* Watch for trespassing, suspicious activity, unauthorized persons, and other unusual activity.

* Write clear, factual, accurate, and time-stamped reports.

* Follow all post orders, site instructions, and escalation procedures.

* Maintain confidentiality regarding cameras, clients, security procedures, and incidents.



Requirements



* Must speak, read, and write English proficiently.

* Must be dependable, punctual, and able to remain alert throughout the overnight shift.

* Strong observation and attention-to-detail skills.

* Reliable high-speed internet and computer.

* Ability to follow instructions and communicate quickly when an incident occurs.

* Professional report-writing skills.

* CCTV/security monitoring experience is preferred.

* Backup internet and/or backup power is strongly preferred.



This is live security monitoring. The person hired must remain attentive to the cameras throughout the assigned shift and be prepared to immediately document and escalate activity when necessary.

title: B2B Partnership and Outbound Sales Rep (US Cleaning Service, Manhattan)

Manhattan Mint NYC is a premium apartment cleaning service in Manhattan, New York. We are hiring  an outbound rep to build our client base  working US Eastern hours.



Your day is spent on the phone reaching out to the people who need apartment cleaning again and again. We provide the playbook, the scripts, and the places to look. You bring the persistence.



Who you will be calling



Furnished apartment and short-term rental operators who need turnover cleaning between guests. Our best clients, because the work repeats weekly.

Real estate agents and rental brokers who need move-in and move-out cleanings for clients.

Property managers and managing agents who keep approved vendor lists for their buildings.

Related businesses that deal with empty or dirty apartments: movers, renovation contractors, home stagers, interior designers.



What you will do



25 to 35 outbound calls and 15 to 20
s per day.

Leave short voi

Monitor Manhattan

title: Assistant
description:
# Virtual Assistant — Personal + Business



I'm looking for a **smart, reliable virtual assistant** who can help me with both my startup and everyday personal stuff.



I'm not looking for someone who just waits for very detailed instructions. I want someone I can message with something like **“Can you figure this out for me?”** and trust that you'll research it, make calls if needed, and come back with a good answer.



### What you'll be helping me with



For my startup, **Artha**:



* Schedule meetings and manage my calendar

* Coordinate back-and-forth with people to find meeting times

* Send calendar invites

* Reply to straightforward
s

* Keep track of things I need to follow up on

* Do random research and admin work when needed



For personal stuff:



* Find flights and tickets

* Research hotels and make reservations

* Make restaurant reservations

* Find and schedule appointments

* Call businesses and get things sorted out

* Research products/services and compare options

* Help plan trips

* Handle other random things that come up



I also have an **Airbnb**, so you'll sometimes:



* Reply to guests

* Answer questions

* Coordinate with cleaners or maintenance

* Help deal with small issues that come up



### What I'm looking for



You should have **very good spoken and written English** and be comfortable talking to people on the phone in the U.S.



Ideally, you've worked as a VA or assistant for a U.S.-based client before.



More than anything, I'm looking for someone who's **resourceful and can figure things out independently**.



For example, if I say:



*"Find me a good flight from San Francisco to New York next Thursday."*



Don't just send me a screenshot of Google Flights. Look at the times, price, stops, baggage, etc. and tell me:



*"I found these three. I think #2 is the best because..."*



That's the kind of help I'm looking for.



### Hours & Pay



I'm thinking **15-20hours/week to start**, and it could become full-time if it's a good fit.



You'll need some availability during **U.S. Pacific Time**, especially when something requires phone calls or scheduling.



**Pay: $5-7 USD/hour depending on experience.** I'm happy to pay more for someone who's really good and makes my life easier.



I'm looking for someone **long term**, not just for a few weeks.



### To apply



Tell me a little about yourself, what kind of VA/assistant work you've done, whether you've worked with U.S. clients, your hourly rate, and what hours you're available.



Also tell me whether you're comfortable **calling U.S. businesses and handling things on my behalf**.



And answer this quick example:



*"I need to go from San Francisco to Las Vegas tomorrow afternoon, stay somewhere nice for two nights, and have a good dinner around 7:30 PM tomorrow. Figure it out for me."*



Tell me briefly how you'd handle that request.



Start your message with **“I can figure it out”** so I know you actually read the post.

title: Executive Assistant / Online Business Manager (Right-Hand to the Founder)
description:
Hi, I'm Renee. I am building my own business called Renee Firth Co. It is all about me and my work. It has a few parts:



One on one coaching

ASD Mum Club, a club for mums who have kids with autism

Live events

Speaking on stage

A podcast. This is my long form content. People can watch it on YouTube or listen on the podcast apps.



The parts may change over time. Some may grow. Some may stop. But I stay in the middle of it all. I need someone calm and steady by my side as it grows.



A bit about my team. We are small. Right now it is me and a couple of helpers. We all wear a few hats. And we get a lot done. I want that from you too. Someone who jumps in and makes things happen.



I am looking for my right-hand helper, an Executive Assistant. Over time it can grow into an Online Business Manager. That just means the person who runs the day to day of the whole business, so I can stay on the big picture. Someone I can trust to keep things going when I am busy. And to hold the fort if I am ever sick or away. This is not just simple admin. I want someone who can run things so nothing stops when I step back.



Here is how it works. You will start small, about 5 hours a week, looking after my social media and my Circle community. As you settle in and I trust you more, your hours will grow, your pay will grow, and you will take on more of the list below. So even though we start small, I need someone who can grow into all of it. Please only apply if that excites you.



What you would help me with (this is the whole role over time):



Keep things running behind the scenes when I cannot. The day to day jobs that keep the business going.

Upload my content. Podcast episodes, and blog posts on WordPress.

Be my social media manager on Instagram. Post my content, reply to comments, and do a little daily engagement in my voice. About 15 minutes a day is plenty for Instagram.

Upload and schedule my other social content too. YouTube, TikTok, and
.

Look after Pinterest. Make and schedule pins that bring people to our website.

Send my
 newsletters in Kit.

Look after our Circle community, where our membership lives. Post my content there, welcome new people, send them their welcome
s and forms, reply kindly, and keep it warm and active.

Run my fortnightly Zoom sessions. Sometimes you host on camera. Sometimes you set up and run the tech while I lead. Then download the recording and upload it where it goes.

Work with the person who hosts my online workshops to line up dates and times for the next ones.

Look after the inbox, calendar, bookings, reminders, and confirmations.

Help plan the podcast and live events behind the scenes, not run them. Things like show notes, booking guests, and getting quotes from venues ahead of time. You would not run events on the day. I will have someone else for that.

Keep projects and to do lists on track so things happen on time.

Be my calm assistant when I am away, so nothing important gets missed.



What I am looking for in you:



You are organised. You finish what you start.

You are warm and kind when you talk to people. This matters a lot. Many of the people we help are mums going through a hard time.

You can take things on yourself. You make smart, informed choices on your own.

You are calm and steady. I need to trust you with a lot.

You speak and write clear, friendly English.

You are good with AI tools, mainly Claude, and also ChatGPT. You use them to work faster and smarter. Things like drafting, tidying writing, sorting ideas, and making our whole workflow smoother.

You are happy to start with a few tasks and grow into the whole role.

It helps if you have worked for a digital business before.



Tools we use:



Kit for our
 newsletters

WordPress for our blog

Circle for our membership community

Instagram, YouTube, TikTok,
, and Pinterest for social

Zoom for our sessions

Claude and ChatGPT for working smarter, mainly Claude

Gmail for our inbox

Google Calendar for my diary

Google Drive for our files

Slack, so you and I can chat easily

Our website, 



Hours:



About 5 hours a week to start, looking after my social media and my Circle community.

Your hours and pay will grow over time as you take on more and as I trust you with more.

Also more during busy times, or when I am sick or away.



How to apply:



Well done for reading this far. That already tells me something good about you. Here is what to do:



1. Start your reply with the word "Sunflower". That way I know you read the whole thing.



2. Tell me about a time you kept things going while the boss was away.



3. Many of the mums we help are tired and stretched. They love their kids with autism to bits, but some days are really hard. Picture one of these mums finding our little community. What would you want her to feel? And tell me why helping mums like her matters to you.



4. Tell me in a few plain words why this job feels right for you.



5. If we go forward, I will ask you to do one quick free personality test before we chat.



I read every reply myself. I can't wait to find the right person.



Thank you, Renee

title: Estimator
description:
REMOTE CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATOR

Philippines-Based | Full-Time | U.S. Commercial Construction



Oceanview Building Group is a South Florida general contractor specializing in premium healthcare interiors, including dental offices, medical clinics, and cosmetic surgery facilities.



We are looking for an experienced Construction Estimator, who can independently prepare accurate takeoffs, detailed estimates, subcontractor scopes, and bid comparisons for U.S. commercial construction projects.



This is not an entry-level position. We need someone who understands construction drawings, knows how projects are built, and can identify missing scope before it becomes a costly change order.



Key Responsibilities



* Review architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection drawings.

* Complete accurate quantity takeoffs and detailed cost estimates.

* Develop scopes of work organized by CSI division and trade.

* Prepare subcontractor bid packages and invitations to bid.

* Review, compare, and level subcontractor proposals.

* Identify exclusions, missing scope, drawing conflicts, and constructability concerns.

* Request pricing from subcontractors and suppliers.

* Prepare conceptual budgets when drawings are incomplete.

* Maintain estimating templates, historical pricing, and subcontractor databases.

* Assist with value engineering and cost-saving recommendations.

* Prepare clear estimate summaries for management review.

* Support project handoff from estimating to operations.



Required Qualifications



* At least 4 years of construction estimating experience.

* Experience estimating U.S. commercial interior construction projects.

* Strong ability to read and interpret complete construction documents.

* Working knowledge of architectural and MEP trades.

* Experience preparing detailed takeoffs—not just collecting subcontractor prices.

* Proficiency with Bluebeam and takeoff or estimating software such as PlanSwift, STACK, or similar.

* Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to meet deadlines.

* Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote workspace.

* Ability to work hours that overlap with the U.S. Eastern Time Zone.



Preferred Experience



* Healthcare, dental, medical office, surgical facility, or laboratory construction.

* South Florida or other U.S. commercial construction markets.

* Buildertrend or similar construction-management software.

* Subcontractor solicitation and bid leveling.

* Creating estimating systems, templates, and cost databases.



What Success Looks Like



* Estimates are complete, organized, and easy to review.

* Quantities are supported by documented takeoffs.

* Scope gaps and conflicts are identified before bidding.

* Subcontractor proposals are properly compared and leveled.

* Deadlines are met without sacrificing accuracy.

* Projects are handed to operations with clear scopes and budgets.



Application Requirements



Please submit:



1. Your résumé.

2. A brief description of the U.S. commercial projects you have estimated.

3. A sample takeoff, estimate, or bid-leveling sheet with confidential information removed.

4. The estimating software you use.

5. Your expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos.

6. Your availability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours.



Selected candidates will complete a paid estimating test using a small commercial construction plan set.



Employment Type: Full-time, long-term remote position

Location: Philippines

Schedule: Monday through Friday with U.S. Eastern Time overlap

Company: Oceanview Building Group

description:
NGIL Australia is an Australian transport and bulk material supply company, and we are looking for a talented video editor to help us create high-quality short-form social media content for Instagram,
 and LinkedIn.



This will initially be a paid trial project editing two videos, with the opportunity for ongoing work if we find the right person.



Who Our Content Is For



Our social media audience includes:



Truck drivers and trucking enthusiasts

Transport and logistics professionals

Civil construction and infrastructure companies

Current and potential NGIL customers

Quarries and material suppliers

Truck manufacturers and industry partners

People interested in trucks, heavy machinery and construction



Our content should feel professional, modern, powerful and premium, while still being engaging for people who genuinely love trucks.



FIRST PROJECT – NEW WESTERN STAR TRUCK



We have recently added a new Western Star Rigid + 5-Axle Dog combination to our fleet.



We have professional drone footage, ground-level footage, close-up detail footage, interior footage and photos.



From this footage, we would like two completely different social media reels.



VIDEO 1 – New Truck Detail / Specification Reel



Approximately 30–45 seconds, vertical 9:16.



This video should feel similar to a premium new car/truck reveal or automotive specification video.



We want to showcase the truck itself as well as its smaller details.



Possible opening:



NEW TO THE NGIL FLEET



Western Star | Rigid + 5-Axle Dog



The footage available includes details such as:



Western Star badge

Front grille

Headlights / daytime running lights

NGIL branding

Chrome details

Wheels and tyres

Close-up footage travelling along the axles

Full truck and trailer

Different exterior angles

Driver opening the door and climbing into the truck

Western Star steering wheel

Dashboard

Dashboard lighting up

Engine starting

Screens and technology

Gear selector

Interior wide shots



We would like some specifications introduced using small, clean, animated text, for example:



ENGINE

DD16 EPA24



POWER

600 HP



We DO NOT want text over every clip.



Some sections should simply use short, satisfying detail shots cut to the music.



VIDEO 2 – Cinematic / Drone Truck Reel



Approximately 20–30 seconds, vertical 9:16.



This video is less informational and more about creating a cool, powerful cinematic reveal of the truck.



We have drone footage and multiple wide-angle shots that should be the main focus.



Think:



Truck commercial × cinematic automotive reel × social media



This edit should rely heavily on:



Drone footage

Driving shots

Full truck shots

Different exterior angles

Movement

Music

Strong cuts/transitions



There should be very minimal text.



For example:



THE NEWEST ADDITION TO THE NGIL FLEET



Then allow the footage and music to tell the story.



Editing Style We Are Looking For



DO:



Premium automotive-style editing

Cinematic editing

Strong music selection

Cuts timed to music

Clean text animation

Subtle speed ramps

Professional colour grading

Smooth transitions

Strong opening hook

Mobile-first 9:16 editing



PLEASE AVOID:



Excessive transitions

Cheap templates

Gaming-style effects

Lots of emojis

Overly flashy text

Text covering the truck

Excessive zoom effects

Heavy filters

Making the content feel like a slideshow



Our brand colours are navy blue, red and white.



The truck and NGIL branding should remain visually accurate.



IMPORTANT



Please do not mirror/reverse footage because this reverses the NGIL signage on our trucks.



Do not heavily crop the truck or change the colours of the vehicle/branding.

title: AI Video Creative Specialist – Direct Response Dropshipping Ads
description:
# AI Video Creative Specialist – Direct Response Dropshipping Ads



**Starting Salary: $700 USD/month**

**Salary review and increase after 3 months based on performance**



**Schedule: Monday – Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM | Full-Time**



---



## About Us



We are a fast-growing **pure dropshipping company** specializing in men's products.



We are **not a traditional e-commerce brand**.



Our business model is based on constantly researching, testing and scaling new products through paid advertising.



Every week, our team identifies products with potential.



We provide the products, the target audiences and the information you need.



Your job is to take those products and audiences and create **high-converting video advertising creatives** specifically for
 and Instagram.



This is a **direct-response advertising position**.



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to make beautiful videos.



We need someone who understands:



**Product + Audience + Marketing Angle + Creative + Conversion**



The purpose of every video is ultimately to **make the customer want the product and take action.**



---



# THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL VIDEO EDITING JOB



This is extremely important.



We are **not hiring someone to make nice-looking videos just for the sake of making videos.**



We need someone who understands how to use video to **market and sell products.**



A beautiful video that gets attention but does not make someone interested in buying is not a successful creative for us.



You need to understand:



* Who the target customer is

* What the customer wants

* What problem or desire the product addresses

* What angle will attract that customer

* What will make someone stop scrolling

* How to present the product quickly

* How to create desire

* How to make the product look appealing

* How to create a reason to continue watching

* How to turn attention into purchasing intent



You are creating **advertising creatives**, not entertainment content.



---



# YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY



Every week, our team will provide you with new products that have **potential to be scaled through paid advertising**.



We will also provide information about the target audiences we are testing.



You will be responsible for understanding the product and audience and creating multiple AI-powered video creatives designed specifically to attract those customers.



Videos will generally be:



**12–15 seconds long.**



Your target production volume will be approximately:



**20+ usable advertising creatives per day.**



The objective is to give our Meta Ads team a large number of strong creatives that they can test and use to identify winning angles.



---



# WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your responsibilities include:



* Create 20+ usable video advertising creatives per day.

* Create videos specifically for *
 and Instagram advertising**.

* Study the product before creating the creative.

* Understand the target audience for each product.

* Develop different marketing angles for the same product.

* Use AI tools to create product-focused videos.

* Create different hooks and concepts.

* Create different visual presentations of the same product.

* Create videos designed to stop the scroll.

* Create videos designed to generate purchasing interest.

* Keep the product as the main focus.

* Make sure the product remains accurate and recognizable.

* Review every video before submission.

* Organize completed creatives properly.

* Communicate constantly with the team.

* Work quickly and efficiently.

* Continuously improve your production workflow.

* Research new AI tools and techniques that can improve our creative output.



---



# YOU MUST UNDERSTAND DROPSHIPPING ADVERTISING



We want someone who understands the difference between **traditional e-commerce/brand marketing and direct-response dropshipping.**



We are constantly testing new products.



We are not creating months of content around one established brand identity.



A product can be discovered today, tested through advertising, and potentially scaled rapidly if the numbers show that customers want it.



That means our creative team needs to be extremely adaptable.



You may work on:



* A jacket today

* A men's shirt tomorrow

* A completely different men's product next week



You must be able to quickly understand:



**What is this product?**



**Who would buy it?**



**Why would they want it?**



**What would make them stop scrolling?**



**What angle would make them interested?**



**How can we communicate that visually in 12–15 seconds?**



That is the skill we are looking for.



---



# META ADS EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must have real experience creating *
 and Instagram advertising creatives.**



We are not interested in applicants whose primary experience is:



* YouTube videos

* Entertainment content

* General social media videos

* Wedding videos

* Corporate videos

* Cinematic filmmaking

* Traditional video editing without advertising experience



Your experience must be directly relevant to **performance advertising**.



You should understand how
/Instagram users behave and how creative affects advertising performance.



You should understand concepts such as:



* Scroll-stopping hooks

* Product-focused creatives

* Creative angles

* Audience psychology

* Desire and purchasing intent

* Product benefits

* Problem/solution angles

* Curiosity

* Visual demonstrations

* Creative testing

* Direct-response advertising



---



# YOU NEED TO THINK LIKE A MARKETER



This is one of the most important requirements.



Before creating a video, you should be asking yourself:



**Who am I making this video for?**



**What does this person care about?**



**Why would they want this product?**



**What would make them stop scrolling?**



**What visual would make them interested?**



**What would make them want to see the product?**



**What would make them want to buy it?**



We don't want someone who simply opens an AI tool and starts generating random videos.



We want someone who thinks:



**"I understand the audience. I understand the product. Now how do I create a creative that converts?"**



---



# AI EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must already have professional experience using AI video-generation tools.



You should be comfortable with:



* Image-to-video

* AI video generation

* Product animation

* AI-generated environments

* Scene generation

* Product-focused video generation

* Creative variations

* Video enhancement

* Rapid creative production



You are not required to use any particular platform.



In fact, we prefer someone who is constantly researching and discovering **new and better AI tools.**



If a new AI video platform comes out that can make our production faster or better, we want you to be the person who discovers it and brings it to the team.



---



# EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



You must have:



* **2–4+ years of professional video/advertising experience**

* Real experience creating *
 and Instagram video ads**

* Experience creating direct-response advertising creatives

* Strong understanding of marketing products through video

* Professional AI video-generation experience

* Strong understanding of audience and customer psychology

* Ability to create multiple creative concepts quickly

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong organization skills

* Excellent communication

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to follow instructions

* Ability to learn new tools quickly



**This is an expert-level position.**



If you are still learning the basics of AI video creation or advertising, please do not apply.



---



# WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO IS:



### FAST



You understand that we test products and creatives at high volume.



You need to consistently produce **20+ usable creatives per day.**



### CREATIVE



You can take one product and develop multiple completely different advertising angles.



### MARKETING-MINDED



You understand that the objective is not simply to make a good-looking video.



The objective is to **sell the product.**



### PROACTIVE



You don't wait for someone to tell you every step.



You research new tools.



You test new techniques.



You bring ideas.



You find ways to make the workflow faster and better.



### ORGANIZED



You can manage multiple products, creative concepts and files without creating confusion.



### COMMUNICATIVE



We work as a team.



Constant communication is important.



If something isn't clear, ask.



If you have an idea, share it.



If you find a better way, tell us.



### AMBITIOUS



We want someone who wants to grow professionally and financially.



We are building a company where people who become more skilled, more productive and more valuable can take on more responsibility and earn more.



### ENERGETIC



We want someone who has energy, initiative and a genuine desire to improve their life and career.



This is a fast-moving company.



We need people who want to move forward with us.



---



# HOW OUR WORKFLOW WORKS



Our process is straightforward.



### STEP 1 — PRODUCT



Our research team identifies products with potential to be scaled.



We provide you with the product.



### STEP 2 — AUDIENCE



We provide information about the audience we are targeting.



You need to understand that audience.



### STEP 3 — CREATIVE STRATEGY



You determine how the product should be presented to that audience.



You develop different hooks, angles and concepts.



### STEP 4 — PRODUCTION



You use AI and your video-production skills to create approximately **20+ creatives per day.**



Each video is approximately **12–15 seconds.**



### STEP 5 — QUALITY CONTROL



You review every creative.



The product must remain accurate.



The video must make sense.



There must be no obvious AI errors.



The creative must be suitable for advertising.



### STEP 6 — SUBMISSION



You organize and submit the completed creatives to our Meta Ads team.



The advertising team then tests the creatives.



---



# PRODUCT ACCURACY IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



AI can create incredible visuals, but it can also distort products.



You must have an extremely strong eye for detail.



You need to catch:



* Incorrect product colors

* Product shape changing

* Missing buttons

* Incorrect details

* Distorted clothing

* Incorrect logos

* Unrealistic movements

* Product changing between scenes

* AI artifacts

* Product becoming unrecognizable



We are selling the actual product.



The creative must represent the actual product accurately.



---



# SALARY & CAREER GROWTH



**Starting Salary: $700 USD/month**



After your first **3 months**, your performance will be reviewed and your salary will be increased based on your performance.



Your growth will depend on:



* Quality

* Speed

* Reliability

* Creative performance

* Initiative

* Communication

* Skill development

* Ability to take on more responsibility

* Contribution to the company's growth



We want people who grow with us.



If you become faster, better, more creative and more valuable to the company, your compensation and responsibilities can increase accordingly.



This is intended to be a **long-term position.**



---



# EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* Reliable MacBook or high-performance computer

* Smartphone

* Fast and reliable internet

* Quiet workspace

* Ability to work Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM

* Access to the AI/video tools required for your workflow



---



# PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



Do not apply if:



* You have never created AI videos.

* You have no experience creating advertising creatives.

* You have never created
/Instagram video ads.

* Your experience is mainly YouTube.

* Your experience is mainly entertainment content.

* You are only a traditional video editor.

* You are a beginner with AI video tools.

* You don't understand direct-response advertising.

* You don't understand how to market a product through video.

* You cannot consistently produce 20+ creatives per day.

* You prefer spending hours creating one video.

* You need someone to teach you the basics.

* You are not organized.

* You are not proactive.

* You don't communicate well.

* You don't like fast-paced work.

* You are not interested in learning new AI tools.

* You are looking for an easy or low-effort job.

* You don't have a strong desire to grow professionally.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Please use the subject:



**AI VIDEO – [Your Name]**



Please answer **ALL** questions below.



### 1. EXPERIENCE



How many years of professional experience do you have creating video advertising creatives?



How many years have you been using AI video-generation tools?



---



### 2.
 / INSTAGRAM EXPERIENCE



How many years have you been creating video ads specifically for *
 and Instagram?**



Tell us what types of products you have advertised.



---



### 3. AI TOOLS



List all AI video tools you currently use.



Tell us what you use each tool for.



Which AI tool do you believe is currently the fastest for producing direct-response advertising creatives at scale?



Explain why.



---



### 4. PRODUCTION VOLUME



What is the highest number of **usable advertising creatives** you have personally produced in one day?



How long did it take?



Which tools did you use?



---



### 5. MARKETING THINKING



Imagine we give you a men's jacket and tell you that the target audience is men who are interested in upgrading their everyday style.



Give us **5 completely different advertising concepts** you would create.



We don't want five different visual styles.



We want five different **marketing angles.**



Explain briefly:



* Who each concept is targeting

* What the hook would be

* What the customer should feel

* Why you think the concept could convert



---



### 6. WORKFLOW



Imagine we give you **10 new products** and expect approximately **20+ video creatives per day.**



Explain exactly how you would organize your day and workflow to achieve that production volume while maintaining quality.



---



### 7. INITIATIVE



Tell us about a time you discovered a new AI tool, advertising technique or workflow yourself and introduced it into your work.



---



### 8. GROWTH



Where do you see yourself professionally in the next 3–5 years?



What skills do you want to develop?



What would make you want to stay and grow with a company long-term?



---



# IMPORTANT



**Please do not send generic AI-generated answers.**



We are looking for someone with **real professional experience**.



We want someone who understands that:



**Making a video ? making an advertisement.**



And:



**Making a beautiful advertisement ? making a converting advertisement.**



We need someone who understands the complete process:



**Product ? Audience ? Marketing Angle ? Creative ? Attention ? Desire ? Purchase**



If you understand direct-response dropshipping advertising, have real
/Instagram advertising experience, know how to use AI to produce creatives quickly, and have the initiative and ambition to become better every day, **we want to hear from you.**



**Apply only if you are confident that you can perform at a professional level from day one.**

title: Social Media Graphic Designer – NGIL Australia
description:
Social Media Graphic Designer – NGIL Australia



NGIL Australia is an Australian transport and bulk material supply company, and we're looking for a creative Social Media Graphic Designer to help us elevate our content across Instagram,
 and LinkedIn.







What You'll Be Creating



A large part of the role will involve turning information and ideas we provide into professional, engaging and easy-to-understand social media graphics.



Content will include:



Educational transport and trucking content



Heavy vehicle and road safety graphics



Truck blind spot education



Driver safety information



Construction material education



Material comparison graphics



Recycled and sustainable construction material content



Truck and fleet facts



New truck announcements



Project highlights and statistics



Company milestones



Employee content



Testimonials



Recruitment graphics



Infographics



Instagram carousels



General branded social media content



Example Project - Heavy Vehicle Blind Spots



We may provide you with an industry resource about heavy vehicle blind spots containing the information we want to communicate.



Rather than simply copying the original graphic, we would like you to creatively turn the information into an original NGIL-branded educational post.



For example, we could provide a photograph of one of our actual NGIL trucks and have you create a visual around the truck showing the different blind spot areas, supported by simple educational information.



We want to increasingly combine:



Real NGIL photography + graphic design + typography + educational information



Our Style



NGIL's primary brand colours are:



Navy Blue · Red · White



We will provide our logos, brand assets, truck photography, project photography, information and reference examples.



Our content should feel:



Modern · Clean · Strong · Professional · Industrial · Engaging



Our audience includes truck drivers, transport professionals, civil construction companies, infrastructure contractors, customers, suppliers and people interested in trucks and heavy vehicles.



We therefore need designs that are professional enough for LinkedIn and a B2B audience, while still being visually engaging for Instagram and
.



What We're Looking For



We want someone with a strong understanding of:



Social media design



Typography



Visual hierarchy



Branding



Infographic design



Instagram carousel design



Working with photography



Turning information into simple visual content



We DON'T want someone who simply takes a generic Canva template and adds our logo.



We're looking for a designer who can help us develop a consistent and recognisable visual style for NGIL's social media content.



How We Would Work Together



Generally, we would provide:



Topic/Idea + Information + NGIL Photos/Assets + Reference/Inspiration



You would then use your creativity to turn this into the finished social media content.



We are happy to provide clear briefs and feedback, but we're also looking for someone who can bring their own creative ideas and recommendations to the designs.



How to Apply



Please send us:



A short introduction about yourself.



A link to your portfolio.



3–5 examples of your best social media designs.



Examples of educational graphics, infographics or social media carousels are strongly preferred.



Which programs you use – Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.



Your hourly rate.



Your usual turnaround time.



Whether you're interested in ongoing work.



Please start your application with “NGIL DESIGN” so we know you've read the full job description.



We'd love to find someone we can work with long-term who can help us elevate NGIL's social media presence and build a much stronger, consistent visual identity.

title: Airbnb - Guest Relations & Operations Specialist
description:
Job Title: STR – Guest Relations & Operations Specialist

Schedule: Monday–Thursday and Saturday, 10:00 AM–9:00 PM Eastern Time, with a 1-hour lunch.

Hours: 40–45 hours per week expected; up to 50 hours when business needs require it, with approval.

Pay: $6–$8 USD per hour depending on experience, communication ability, judgment, and property-management experience.



About Us:

Key Getaways is a premier property management firm founded by a former futures trader who traded the chaos of the Chicago markets for a passion-driven mission: creating first-class travel experiences for families. We specialize in transforming vacation rentals into high-performing assets across national markets, currently anchored in the Smoky Mountains of Tennessee. 



Our culture is built on the "family-style" values of kindness and leadership, yet we operate with the precision and scalability of a high-growth tech company. We are a lean, execution-focused team that rejects micro-management in favor of individual ownership, and we are looking for a visionary partner to help us build the systems that will support our goals.



Accountability:

1. Guest Experience Ownership

*Own guest communication from pre-arrival through checkout, including questions, concerns, complaints, and urgent issues.

*Respond quickly, professionally, and empathetically while protecting the company and property owner’s interests.

*Use sound judgment to resolve routine guest issues independently and escalate higher-risk situations with a recommended solution.

*Follow issues through to completion rather than simply handing them off.

2. Maintenance & Vendor Coordination

*Serve as the primary coordinator when a guest reports a maintenance, housekeeping, pool/hot-tub, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, lock, internet, or other property issue.

*Contact the appropriate maintenance person or vendor, clearly communicate the problem, coordinate access, and track the issue until resolved.

*Keep guests informed while work is underway and confirm the repair or service was completed successfully.

*Source new vendors when necessary and help maintain a dependable vendor network in each market.

*Identify repeat property issues and bring patterns to management’s attention.

3. Operational Ownership & Decision-Making

*Take ownership of assigned operational issues from discovery through resolution.

*Make informed decisions with limited information while balancing guest satisfaction, urgency, cost, and owner impact.

*Escalate thoughtfully with context and proposed solutions—not just problems.

*Document important incidents, actions taken, vendor outcomes, and follow-up items.

4. Process Improvement & Systems

*Identify recurring guest or operational problems and recommend ways to prevent them.

*Help create and improve SOPs for guest communication, maintenance escalation, vendor dispatch, refunds/credits, and emergency situations.

*Maintain accurate notes and task tracking so another team member can quickly understand the status of an issue.

*Help improve workflows as Key Getaways grows.

5. Team Communication & Leadership Readiness

*Communicate proactively with management and other team members about urgent issues, risks, and unresolved items.

*Work effectively with cleaners, maintenance technicians, pool/hot-tub companies, handymen, and other vendors.

*Support onboarding and training of future guest-relations team members as the company grows.

*Model accountability, professionalism, urgency, and high-quality work.



Tasks:

*Monitor and respond to guest messages across Airbnb, Vrbo, direct bookings, and the property-management system.

*Handle same-day guest needs including check-in problems, access issues, missing items, cleanliness concerns, amenity questions, and property malfunctions.

*Troubleshoot issues remotely when possible and dispatch the correct vendor when on-site help is needed.

*Coordinate maintenance and vendor schedules, provide access information, and follow up until completion.

*Keep guests updated during active issues and document the final resolution.

*Review open operational tasks and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

*Communicate significant incidents, potential refunds, property damage, safety concerns, or owner-impacting issues to management.

*Help identify reliable replacement vendors and obtain pricing when needed.

*Review upcoming arrivals for known property issues that could affect the next guest.

*Assist with operational projects and process improvements during lower-volume periods.



Expectations:

1. Required Traits

*Excellent written and spoken English; communication quality is critical.

*Strong ownership mentality—you see an issue through to resolution.

*Calm and professional under pressure, including when guests are upset.

*Resourceful problem solver who can make reasonable decisions independently.

*Strong follow-up skills and ability to manage several open issues at once.

*Comfortable communicating firmly but respectfully with vendors and holding them accountable.

*High attention to detail and accurate documentation.

*Reliable during scheduled hours and responsive to time-sensitive guest issues.

*Comfortable working in a fast-changing small-business environment.

*Attention to detail is mandatory: secret code = KGGROS0826

2. Leadership Mindset

*Treats guest and maintenance problems as issues to solve, not simply messages to forward.

*Looks for root causes and ways to prevent recurring problems.

*Takes initiative without waiting for step-by-step instructions.

*Can respectfully challenge a vendor, cleaner, or teammate when work is incomplete or below standard.

*Wants increased responsibility as the company and guest-relations function grow.

3. Tools (Experience Preferred, Not Required)

*Airbnb and Vrbo

*Guesty or another vacation-rental property management system

*Breezeway or similar maintenance/operations software

*Slack

*Airtable

*Google Workspace

*Dialpad or similar phone/text system

*AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude for drafting, troubleshooting, and process improvement

4.Nice-to-Have

*Previous guest-services, hospitality, vacation-rental, hotel, or property-management experience.

*Experience coordinating maintenance technicians, cleaners, contractors, or vendors.

*Experience handling difficult customers and resolving complaints.

*Experience managing multiple properties or multiple simultaneous service issues.

*Prior informal or formal leadership experience.

*Experience creating SOPs or improving operational workflows.



Salary (Dollar Rate):

Position & Length: Remote contractor; initial 12-month engagement with the opportunity to continue indefinitely.

Rate of Pay: $6–$8 USD/hour depending on experience.

Scheduled Hours Minimum: 40 hours per week; hours must be tracked.

Scheduled Hours Maximum: Up to 50 hours per week; hours above the normal schedule require approval.

Agreed Schedule: Tuesday–Thursday and Saturday, 10:00 AM–9:00 PM Eastern Time, with a 1-hour lunch.

Pay Schedule: Twice monthly (15th and 30th of the month) via Wise or another agreed payment method, with submission of hours worked.

Performance Bonus: Optional performance bonus may be offered based on agreed KPIs at the end of the year.



TO APPLY: 

Subject Line please add: KG GROS

Please have an ID score of 70+

Please provide the secret code in the message

title: Funding, Grants & Financial Opportunity Research & Application Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Funding, Grants & Financial Opportunity Research & Application Specialist to help us FIND, VERIFY, APPLY, TRACK, and FOLLOW UP on legitimate U.S.-based financial opportunities.



THIS IS NOT A BASIC VA OR ENTRY-LEVEL RESEARCH POSITION.



You must already have experience researching and/or applying for U.S. grants, business funding, government programs, financial-assistance programs, mortgage/homeowner assistance, rebates, credits, incentives, competitions, or similar opportunities.



RESPONSIBILITIES:



• Research legitimate U.S. business grants and funding opportunities.

• Research personal financial-assistance programs, rebates, credits, incentives, scholarships, and other legitimate opportunities.

• Research mortgage, homeowner, housing, home-repair, energy-efficiency, and property-related assistance programs.

• Focus particularly on opportunities applicable to South Carolina and Florida when relevant.

• Verify every opportunity using official or authoritative sources.

• Review eligibility requirements and determine whether we appear to qualify BEFORE recommending an opportunity.

• Provide direct application links, deadlines, financial value, required documents, restrictions, and recommended next steps.

• Prepare and complete applications using approved information.

• Draft application responses and supporting narratives when required.

• Submit applications only when specifically authorized.

• Track applications, deadlines, confirmation numbers, follow-ups, approvals, denials, and results.

• Maintain a clear and organized opportunity/application tracker.

• Follow up on applications and identify additional requirements or documents.



We DO NOT want random Google results, generic grant lists, expired opportunities, irrelevant programs, questionable websites, or unverified AI-generated information.



Quality over quantity. Five legitimate opportunities we can actually pursue are more valuable than 100 random links.



REQUIREMENTS:



• Previous experience researching U.S. grants, funding, government programs, mortgage/homeowner assistance, or similar financial opportunities.

• Experience assisting with actual applications.

• Strong research and verification skills.

• Ability to work independently without constant direction.

• Excellent attention to detail and organization.

• Familiarity with official U.S. government and funding resources is strongly preferred.

• Must understand the difference between grants, loans, rebates, tax credits, reimbursements, subsidies, assistance programs, scholarships, and similar opportunities.



HOW TO APPLY:



Please do not submit a generic VA application.



1. Describe your relevant experience with U.S. grants, funding, government programs, homeowner assistance, rebates, credits, or similar opportunities.



2. Give 3 real examples of opportunities you previously found or helped pursue, including the approximate value, why the client qualified, whether you helped with the application, and the outcome if known.



3. Explain your workflow for finding, verifying, and applying for legitimate financial opportunities for a U.S.-based business owner and homeowner.



4. List the government websites, grant databases, funding resources, housing/mortgage resources, and research tools you have personally used.



The first 30 days will be a paid trial, with the first 7 days serving as an initial performance checkpoint.



Final candidates may also be asked to complete a small PAID skills test.



We are looking for someone who can FIND IT ? VERIFY IT ? APPLY ? TRACK IT ? FOLLOW UP ? REPORT RESULTS.

Company: lowk — anonymous school polls app for US high schoolers Location: Fully remote. Type: Contract, 10 hrs/week to start. Scales with the number of accounts.



The job in one line

You build 10 high school Instagram accounts by finding schools with around a
high school student population and getting the follower count to at least 100.



What you'll do

You'll take 10 lowk school Instagram accounts from zero to a follower base that mirrors the actual student body of each assigned high school, targeting 20% of enrollment followed per account before that account goes public. The core loop is sourcing and following students who have that school named in their bio, and your job is knowing where those students cluster: start with the school's hub accounts — ASB/student government, class-of accounts 
 2028), varsity and JV sports teams, cheer, dance, band, drama, and club accounts — and work systematically through their followers, tagged posts, and follow-backs. From there, mine comment sections: the students commenting on a classmate's post are almost always at the same school, and threading through 5–10 comment sections surfaces entire friend groups faster than follower lists do. Every follow must clear two checks before you hit the button — (1) the bio explicitly names the target high school, and (2) the account belongs to a current high school student, meaning any bio with a college name, a committed-to school, a passed graduation year, or a "c/o" year earlier than this one is skipped, not followed. Equally important is account survival: you are responsible for keeping all 10 accounts unrestricted, which means working inside strict daily follow ceilings, warming new accounts before scaling, spacing actions instead of bursting, and stopping cold on any account that throws an action block rather than pushing through it. You'll log daily follows, follow-back rate, and any restriction events per account in the master sheet, and flag schools where the sourcing pool runs dry before the 20% target.



You will name each account “(school)polls”, either an abbreviated version like “shspolls” or the whole thing like “santiagopolls” depending on availability. You will attach a given bio copy and paste it as the bio of each account, make sure it’s private (super important), and place the school logo on the profile picture.

Core objective: You will keep track of the numbers on a simple spreadsheet. Look for 10 southern California high schools, each with a student population of about
. Get the follower request count to at least 100 on all accounts.

Rules of thumb (non-negotiable):

Warm-up: new account = 80 is the absolute max number of follows you should do on day 1, spread across two different times (40 in the morning, 40 at night for instance), 100 the next day with the same split. Follow at least 5 school based accounts (the school itself, the school’s student council/news, any basketball/volleyball/football teams, etc). Never mass-follow on a fresh account, this will lead to restrictions in following. If this happens, it’ll take even longer to reach the goal.

Blocked = stop: action block means 24–48 hours of zero activity on that account. Do not follow or do anything on that account and move onto the next if restrictions happen. Ensure to tell Cayden, and get back to the account after 2-48 hours have past. Retrying through a block escalates it to a longer or permanent restriction.

No third-party automation tools ever.

No churn: never unfollow to inflate ratio. Follow/unfollow cycling is the single fastest path to a permanent block.



What we're looking for

Required

Experience running multiple social accounts on a fixed daily schedule.

Meticulous. This role is judged almost entirely on whether the right post went out, on the right account, on the right day, with the right school name on it.

Google Sheets.

Reliable internet and a consistent daily working window.

English good enough to read instructions precisely and flag problems clearly. You are not writing content.



Begin your application with "LOWK ROLE" so we know you read this section



Compensation

$35 fixed for the entire project.



How to apply

1, Links to social accounts you've managed, if you can share them.

2, Your timezone and realistic daily working window in US Pacific terms.

3, When can you get started

4, Any questions you may have



We reply to everyone within a day or two.

title: Guest Experience Specialist, Third Coast Elevated Stays
description:
Third Coast Elevated Stays is a locally rooted, family-owned property management company serving the Texas coast markets of Galveston, Corpus Christi, Rockport, Port Aransas, and South Padre Island. We are focused on providing elevated stays for our guests and elevated stewardship for our homeowners. Our goal is to grow in a way that celebrates what makes the Texas coast special - its people, coastal culture, beach communities, and local character - while delivering elevated experiences for guests and thoughtful, reliable stewardship for homeowners.



Tech stack (daily tools): Guesty (PMS + guest inbox), Breezeway (tasks/workorders + cleaning), RingCentral (calls/SMS).



Our Elevated Promises

Everything we do is guided by our Elevated Promises. They are our operating standard and the way we earn five-star stays and trusted, long-term homeowner partnerships.



1. Elevated Guest Engagement: Proactive, elevated hospitality from booking to five-star review. 

We believe vacations are special—something people save for, plan for, and look forward to. Our job is to make every stay feel seamless and memorable. We anticipate needs, communicate early, check in during the stay, and resolve issues quickly with warmth and care. Our guest journey is intentionally crafted to deliver the kind of responsiveness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail that turns great trips into truly elevated experiences.



2. Elevated Home Stewardship: We care for every home as if it were our own.

As homeowners in these markets, we know what true home stewardship looks like. We operate with a proactive mindset of quality, consistency, and pride. Weekly home checks, rigorous cleaning standards, quality control, seasonal readiness, and preventive maintenance are all part of how we ensure every property is clean, protected, and presentation ready, for guests and for you. We treat every home with the same respect and diligence we expect for our own.



3. Elevated Homeowner Partnerships: We treat each home like our own investment.

Every homeowner has different goals – maximizing revenue, balancing personal use, focusing on long-term appreciation, or simply enjoying peace of mind. Our role is to be a true partner in those goals, not simply a property manager. As owners and operators in this region ourselves, our guidance comes from real-world results, not theory. Through regular business reviews, thoughtful design and amenity recommendations, revenue and pricing insights, and brand-building support, we help each property reach its highest potential.



Our Guest Experience team is one of the biggest ways we deliver these promises. This is hospitality work. You are a core part of our team, not an outsourced call-center function.?



Job Description: Guest Experience Specialist - Texas Coast

As a Guest Experience Specialist, you own guest communication and coordination. You are the voice of Third Coast, a core part of our team, and a key driver of five-star stays. You will manage guest messaging and calls, coordinate workorders and cleaning schedules with our local teams and vendors, and bring elevated hospitality and experiences to every stay.



You will own:

• Proactive outreach and warm guest engagement that drives five-star stays

• Guest messaging and phone communication

• Workorder coordination and task follow-through

• Cleaning scheduling and day-to-day coordination with our local team and vendors



Working Hours

We provide live coverage from 7:00am to 11:00pm Central Time (CDT). You will be assigned a consistent shift. On-call after-hour coverage (11:00pm-7:00am CDT) is handled by a separate rotation.



Central Daylight Time (CDT) ? Philippines Time (PHT):

• 7am–3pm CDT ? 8pm–4am PHT

• 11am–7pm CDT ? 12am–8am PHT

• 3pm–11pm CDT ? 4am–12pm PHT

• 11pm–7am CDT ? 12pm–8pm PHT



Compensation and Incentives

• Base pay: $800 USD per month (full-time, based on experience)

• 13th month pay: offered in December (prorated for partial years)

• Monthly 5-Star Bonus: $50 if the monthly average rating is 4.85+ and the review rate is 60%+.

• PTO: Accrues at 1 paid days per month (usable after 90 days; no annual rollover)



Location

These roles are fully remote within the Philippines. 



Role and Responsibilities



Elevated Guest Engagement (Guesty + text/email)

• Answer guest messages (text,
, OTA inbox via Guesty) with warmth, clarity, and genuine care

• Proactively share helpful guidance (arrival, access, weather/roads, home-specific tips) and check in during the stay

• Keep conversations organized and ensure no guest is left waiting or confused

• Ensure every guest experience feels special and elevated



Welcome outreach (required for every reservation)

• Place a welcome phone call to every guest prior to arrival day and send a personalized welcome text

• Confirm access and comfort, offer help, and document any concerns quickly

• Identify opportunities to make the guest’s stay an elevated and memorable experience



Phone support (RingCentral)

• Answer calls quickly and calmly and return missed calls promptly

• Troubleshoot common issues (access, Wi-Fi, amenities, heating/hot tub basics) and escalate when needed



Workorders and coordination (Breezeway)

• Create workorders fast when issues arise and confirm vendor/team acknowledgment

• Track progress, follow up, and close the loop with guests and the local team

• Keep notes and task status clean so handoffs are seamless



Cleaning scheduling and turnovers (Breezeway)

• Coordinate turn cleaning schedules and special requests

• Ensure all turns are scheduled a minimum of one week prior to booking and confirm scheduled cleaner by 6:00pm CDT the night prior to a scheduled cleaning and communicate key notes to cleaners



Documentation and handoffs

• Maintain accurate property notes and updates

• Close out open items before shift end and hand off active issues with clear context



Monthly SLA Standards (required for bonus eligibility)

• Guest messages answered within 15 minutes during your shift (text,
, Guesty inbox)

• Phone calls answered within 30 seconds during your shift

• No open guest messages left at shift end; clean handoffs with clear notes

• Workorders created promptly and vendor/team acknowledgment confirmed quickly



Property Listing Management & OTA Updates

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date listings across Guesty, Airbnb, Vrbo, and other OTAs.

• Update photos, amenities, room configurations, access notes, and seasonal details as needed.

• Ensure descriptions reflect the true guest experience with clear, warm, and helpful language.

• Flag inconsistencies, outdated information, or missing details to the Manager for correction.

• Support seasonal updates (spring break, summer beach season, hurricane season, local events, and holiday periods) to elevate guest expectations and reduce pre-arrival questions.

• Ensure every listing reflects our Elevated Promises — clarity, care, and a welcoming tone.



Local expertise

• Become an expert on Galveston, Corpus Christi, Rockport, Port Aransas, and South Padre Island, including seasonal rhythms, beach conditions, weather impacts, and local norms.

• Learn the best restaurants, cafes, shops, beach activities, family experiences, fishing and boating options, and local attractions in each market so you can offer personalized, concierge-level recommendations that elevate each stay.

• Know our homes in detail: complete Matterport and photo walkthroughs; learn layouts, bedding, amenities, quirks, parking, access instructions, and any “good to know” details for guests.

• Stay current on local events and updates by checking event calendars, tourism sites, and community pages (including relevant local
 groups).

• Use your local and property knowledge proactively to help guests plan better stays, avoid common issues, and feel confidently looked after from booking to checkout.



What we look for

• Excellent written and spoken English and a warm, helpful tone

• Hospitality mindset (you enjoy caring for people, not just closing tickets)

• Strong ownership and follow-through, especially on weekends and busy days

• Detail-oriented and eager to learn homes, markets, and local context

• Comfortable learning and working inside Guesty, Breezeway, and RingCentral

• Reliable internet and a quiet, professional work environment



How to apply



Please submit the following:

• Resume/CV

• 2-minute voice recording introducing yourself and your experience (English)

• Speedtest.net result (screenshot)



Short written samples: How would you respond to the following guest messages?

• “The hot tub isn’t heating. Can you help?”

• “Can we request a late checkout tomorrow?”

• “We’re staying in Port Aransas — any recommendations for a great breakfast spot for our family?”



Short written samples: These three guests message you at the same time. In what order would you respond and why?

• “We can’t get into the home, the code isn’t working.”

• “The Wi-Fi is slow and we need it for work.”

• “Can we check out one hour later?”

title: Part-Time AI & Community Coordinator
description:
Summary Supporting the founder — James (AI system) + Ultra AI Mastermind



Engagement: Ongoing part-time engagement, structured as a series of defined projects



How the work is scoped: Rather than fixed weekly hours, we scope each project together — the work involved, the estimated hours, and a completion timeframe (typically 2–6 weeks per project) — and move to the next project as work develops. There's always a defined next piece, so the engagement is continuous.



Standing meeting: Mondays, 2:30–3:30 PM PST (Building James + Ultra AI Mastermind), Friday sync on anything else (backup)



Location: Remote



Compensation: Please share your expected monthly retainer or hourly rate as part of your application, based on roughly 10–15 hours per week. Project scopes and estimated hours are agreed upfront so the workload stays predictable on both sides.



About the Role



This is a flexible part-time role supporting the founder across a few related areas as they develop. The founder drives the strategy and the direction — this person helps execute, coordinate, and keep things moving. It's a hands-on, collaborative role with regular direct working time with the founder, not just async task-passing.



The work spans three areas, in priority order. None requires prior expertise — the founder drives the direction, and much of the how-to will be guided step-by-step (that's exactly what James is being built to do).



What You'll Do

1. Help build "James" (the founder's AI assistant system)



The founder is building an AI agent — internally called James — that helps manage and delegate his work. He leads the design and build. This person's job is to help execute specific, incremental changes under his direction — small, guided improvements each week, not architecting it from scratch. A working version already exists; the work is steady, directed refinement.



Take direction on specific changes and implement them

Help translate lessons from AI training (AI Advantage Boot Camp, etc.) into small build steps

Keep a running status of open items so each Monday sync starts from a clear picture

2. Support the Ultra AI Mastermind



The mastermind is a biweekly Friday community for Ultra members applying AI in their businesses. The founder already handles most coordination — this person helps lighten and eventually own the routine pieces.



Session logistics: track the rotating host and AI Demo Party presenter, flag gaps ahead of time, handle swaps when someone can't make it, send reminders.

Live participation: join the biweekly Friday sessions, take clear notes, and participate genuinely as a member working on their own goals (with transparency to the group about the coordination role).

Content follow-through: turn session transcripts into newsletter/YouTube content — largely by running established AI prompts on existing transcripts (prompts and direction will be provided).

Member outreach (the main new ongoing task): each week, reach out to a member or two — starting with that session's host/presenter — for a short, genuine check-in on their goals and how AI could help. Track it simply in a shared sheet so members get a consistent touchpoint.

3. General execution & virtual assistant work (guided by James)



An ongoing and growing part of the role: hands-on VA and execution tasks that support the founder's work — for example, content posting, YouTube channel support, and turning mastermind learnings into published content, plus other tasks as they come up.



You don't need to be an expert in any of these. This is the whole point of James: James is being built to mentor whoever's in this seat through each task with a clear, step-by-step process. So the requirement isn't prior expertise — it's the willingness to follow guidance, execute well, and learn as you go. This bucket will grow as James matures and the work evolves, and over time more of it will be coordinated through James rather than directly from the founder.



What Success Looks Like

The mastermind runs smoothly with little firefighting; the founder is only pulled in on things that truly need him.

James makes steady, incremental progress week to week.

Members get a genuine individual touchpoint on a regular cadence.

Session content flows into the newsletter/YouTube without the founder doing it all himself.

Who We're Looking For

Strong communicator — comfortable
ing members, coordinating schedules, and speaking on calls with warmth and discretion.

Organized and self-directed — can track a few moving parts without heavy oversight.

Genuinely interested in AI — uses tools like ChatGPT or Gemini and is curious about how business owners apply AI (enough to participate credibly as a member).

Comfortable in live sessions — joining video calls and breakout rooms, contributing naturally.

Available for the Monday 2:30–3:30 PM PST sync and biweekly Friday sessions, and able to fit project work into their week at their own pace within agreed timeframes.

Weekly sync flexibility: Our primary sync is Monday, with Friday as backup. On the rare week when neither works (e.g., travel), the ability to do a short 30–45 minute call on Saturday morning PST keeps progress from stalling. This won't be a regular occurrence, but occasional flexibility here is part of the role, so we can always keep moving forward.



Nice to have: experience in community management, executive/personal assistance, coaching-program coordination, or client success; familiarity with AI tools or automation; a background where discretion and relationship management matter.



Growth Path



This role is intentionally focused and flexible now, and can grow as James develops and the mastermind expands — potentially toward a larger, ongoing role in how the day-to-day work runs.

THE NAEA-ALIGNED PERSON WE WANT

ABOUT SELLBYCHAT

THIS IS NOT A GENERIC VA ROLE.



Your mission: every active client is checked, every problem has evidence and a next action, every client waiting for an update receives one, and the founder sees only decisions that require founder authority.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Check every active client during your assigned coverage window

- Monitor connection health, reply behaviour, human handoffs and booking tracking

- Triage client questions and operational issues

- Gather screenshots, timestamps, examples and missing access before escalating

- Write short, accurate client updates using approved templates

- Maintain the Client Health sheet and Issue Log

- Chase outstanding client inputs and overdue actions

- Turn repeated questions into clear SOPs

- Escalate urgent or high-impact problems immediately



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



- Guess technical root causes

- Promise features or deadlines without approval

- Issue credits or change commercial terms

- Pause or relaunch a client system without founder approval

- Hide mistakes or make unsupported claims



SUCCESS AFTER 14 DAYS



- 100% of assigned client checks completed

- Every urgent condition escalated correctly

- At least 80% of routine requests handled without founder involvement

- Zero unsupported promises

- Repeated questions converted into procedures

- Founder support time clearly trending down



YOU MUST HAVE



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong judgement and common sense

- Customer support, client operations or SaaS support experience

- Clear, concise writing without fluff

- Confidence asking for missing evidence before acting

- Reliable internet plus a backup plan

- Ability to work independently and follow an escalation system

- Comfort with Google Sheets, chat tools and learning AI software



HOURS AND PAY



- Part-time: 12-15 hours per week

- Consistent Monday-Friday coverage window, agreed before the trial

- USD $8-$10 per hour, based on demonstrated skill and judgement

- First engagement is a 14-day paid trial

- Strong performance can become an ongoing role



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the exact words: CLEAR BEFORE FAST.



Then answer all four questions:



1. A client says: "The bot is broken and I think we are losing leads. Fix it ASAP." Write your exact first reply and list the first five facts you would collect.

2. Describe one work mistake you personally made. How did you communicate it, fix it and prevent it happening again?

title: Creative Video Editor & Social Media Content Producer
description:
I’m building Lost Coast Naturals, a minimalist skincare brand focused on simple, functional products, and I’m looking for someone to work with me on short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.



I’ve been documenting the process of building the brand, so I have a growing library of product footage and photography, along with ideas for videos. What I need help with is consistently turning those ideas into complete pieces of content.



A big part of the role is video editing, but I’m hoping to find someone who can also help shape an idea before we get to the edit. Sometimes I’ll have a clear concept and the footage ready to go. Other times I may need help figuring out the hook, a simple script, how the video should flow, or what additional shots would make it work.



What I’d like help with:



* Editing short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

* Turning rough ideas into clear video concepts

* Helping with hooks, scripts, and video structure

* Giving some direction on how or where to shoot something when needed

* Adding music, text, sound, transitions, and other editing elements where they make sense

* Developing new content ideas and repeatable formats over time



The brand and style:



Lost Coast Naturals is a founder-led brand, so part of the content will tell the story behind the business and bring me into it. But the products and formulas are the hero.



Visually, the brand is minimalist, functional, and somewhat technical, with a clean and restrained aesthetic that intentionally feels different from a typical skincare or lifestyle brand.



More than anything, I’m looking for someone with good taste and creativity. I like collaborating with people who are confident in their skills, have their own point of view, and are comfortable suggesting a different direction when they think it will make the work better.



I want someone who understands what makes social content engaging, but also knows when keeping something simple is the better creative choice.



You can check out 
 to get a feel for the products, photography, and overall brand identity. If you understand the concept and feel like it’s something you can connect with, we’ll probably work well together.



The role:



I’m thinking around 10 to 15 hours per week to start, with the possibility of growing from there.



I’d like to eventually get into a rhythm of creating around 3 to 4 strong pieces of short-form content per week, but I care more about making good content than posting something just to hit a number.



The goal is for this to be collaborative. I’ll continue bringing ideas, setting the creative direction, and shooting content, but I’d also love someone who brings ideas of their own. I’m looking for someone who can help brainstorm new concepts, shape rough ideas into something we can actually make, and then help bring them across the finish line.



If we work well together, I’d love for this to become a long-term role.



To apply:



Please send:



1. A little about yourself and the type of work you normally do.

2. 3 to 5 examples of short-form videos you’ve worked on.

3. Which piece in your portfolio you think best fits the style of Lost Coast Naturals.

4. A little about how involved you typically are beyond editing, such as helping with hooks, scripts, video structure, or planning what footage is needed.

5. Your normal weekly availability.
