title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS

- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

, LinkedIn and other approved channels.

* Identify and contact decision-makers in operations, facilities, information technology, construction, procurement, project management and vendor management.

* Develop relationships with direct clients, general contractors, technology integrators, manufacturers, healthcare organizations, data centers, logistics companies, retailers and other qualified organizations.

* Maintain a consistent pipeline of prospects, qualified opportunities, proposals and follow-up activities.

* Re-engage previous and inactive clients when authorized.



Discovery and Qualification



* Conduct professional discovery calls with U.S.-based prospects.

* Understand the client’s technical requirements, locations, schedule, budget, decision process and purchasing requirements.

* Determine whether opportunities align with the company’s capabilities, pricing and risk standards.

* Identify whether an opportunity involves direct project work, staffing, project delivery or another service model.

* Recognize unprofitable, poorly defined or excessively risky opportunities.

* Collect the information necessary for leadership to make an informed bid-or-no-bid decision.

* Verify decision-makers, purchasing authority, expected timelines and next steps.

* Assess potential clients for payment risk, contract requirements and long-term value.



Sales and Closing



* Present Integrated Staffing’s capabilities professionally and accurately.

* Coordinate technical discussions with operations and project-management personnel.

* Prepare or assist with proposals, presentations, capability statements and follow-up materials.

* Maintain consistent follow-up throughout long sales cycles.

* Address objections and explain the value of the company’s services.

* Support contract discussions while ensuring all pricing and terms receive proper approval.

* Move qualified prospects toward signed agreements and active projects.

* Never make unauthorized promises concerning pricing, staffing, schedules, credit terms, technical capabilities or contractual obligations.

* Never approve contracts, discounts, purchases or pricing without authorization.



Client Development and Retention



* Maintain regular communication with new and existing clients.

* Support a professional transition from sales into project delivery.

* Remain involved after the sale to confirm that expectations are being met.

* Identify additional locations, departments, services and future opportunities.

* Work with project management to address concerns before they damage the client relationship.

* Help turn successful initial projects into repeat business and long-term accounts.

* Maintain accurate records of client commitments, preferences and future needs.

* Conduct structured post-project follow-up to identify additional opportunities.



TECHNICAL UNDERSTANDING



Candidates should understand:



* Low-voltage telecommunications

* Structured cabling

* Cat5e, Cat6 and Cat6A cabling

* Fiber-optic cabling

* Network switches and routers

* Wireless access points

* Racks, cabinets and patch panels

* MDF and IDF telecommunications rooms

* Access-control systems

* Network-infrastructure deployments

* Technical field-service work

* Site surveys

* Bills of materials

* Statements of work

* Technician qualifications and certifications



The salesperson is not expected to engineer or program systems. However, the person must understand the services well enough to ask appropriate questions, accurately represent company capabilities and avoid selling work that cannot be delivered safely or profitably.



CRM AND REPORTING



The Business Development Manager must maintain complete and accurate CRM records, including:



* Prospect and company name

* Decision-maker and contact information

* Lead source

* Services needed

* Estimated opportunity value

* Expected gross margin

* Last contact and next action

* Proposal and contract status

* Probability of closing

* Expected decision date

* Reasons opportunities were won or lost



Weekly reporting must include:



* Outbound calls,
s and LinkedIn outreach

* New decision-makers contacted

* Conversations completed

* Qualified discovery meetings

* New opportunities created

* Proposals submitted

* Estimated pipeline value

* Agreements signed

* Collected revenue and gross profit

* Stalled opportunities and recommended actions

* Client-retention and expansion activity



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



*Must have previous experience bidding government telecommunications projects and must have awarded contracts   

*At least three years of successful B2B sales or business-development experience

* Experience prospecting and selling to U.S.-based companies

* Demonstrated ability to find prospects rather than relying exclusively on inbound leads

* Experience conducting discovery calls, presenting services and closing business

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Confident and professional telephone communication

* Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills

* Experience using a CRM

* Ability to manage a long and complex sales process

* Strong judgment concerning client quality, risk and profitability

* Ability to work independently and remain productive without constant supervision

* Availability during U.S. Eastern business hours

* Reliable high-speed internet, computer, headset and quiet professional workspace



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Experience selling low-voltage, telecommunications, structured-cabling, fiber, networking, access-control, IT-infrastructure or technical field services

* Experience selling staffing, recruiting or project-based services

* Existing relationships with U.S. contractors, integrators, manufacturers, facilities teams or procurement departments

* Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce or another CRM

* Experience responding to RFPs, vendor-registration opportunities or procurement requests

* Experience selling services with project values exceeding $1,000,000

* Proven history of meeting or exceeding sales quotas

* Experience expanding small accounts into long-term client relationships



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Success will be measured by:



* Quality and accuracy of targeted prospect lists

* Consistent outbound prospecting

* Conversations with appropriate decision-makers

* Qualified discovery meetings

* Legitimate opportunities created

* Pipeline quality and estimated value

* Proposal-to-close conversion rate

* New clients acquired

* Collected sales

* Collected gross profit

* Contract quality and payment terms

* Client retention and repeat business

* CRM accuracy and follow-up consistency



The long-term objective is to help build a sales pipeline capable of producing at least $2 million in annual collected revenue while maintaining approved profitability and risk standards.



COMPENSATION AND PAID INTRODUCTORY PERIOD



This position begins with a 60-day paid introductory period.



During the introductory period:



* Base compensation depending on experience 

* Uncapped commission eligibility from the first day

* Leads provided

* Clear weekly activity, pipeline and reporting expectations



After successful completion of the 60-day introductory period:



* Base salary will increase based on experience and progression 

*A full time assistant will be provided 

* Uncapped commission will continue

* Additional bonuses may be available for exceeding quarterly collected-sales and gross-profit targets

* Long-term growth opportunities may include Senior Business Development Manager or Sales Director responsibilities

*Possibility of travel to the USA to meet the team

Commission is based on collected gross profit from qualified business personally originated by the salesperson. Commission is earned only after the client has paid and the associated direct project costs have been recorded.



The specific commission percentage, eligibility period and payment schedule will be included in the written compensation agreement.



INTRODUCTORY-PERIOD EVALUATION



The salesperson will not be evaluated solely on closed revenue during the introductory period because complex B2B sales may require a longer sales cycle.



Performance will be evaluated based on:



* Understanding of the company’s services and ideal clients

* Quality and accuracy of target prospect lists

* Consistent outbound calls,
s and LinkedIn outreach

* Conversations with appropriate U.S.-based decision-makers

* Qualified discovery meetings scheduled and completed

* Legitimate opportunities added to the CRM

* Estimated pipeline value and gross-profit potential

* Quality of discovery notes and follow-up

* Proposals or pricing opportunities developed

* Accuracy and consistency of CRM records

* Professional communication and reliability

* Ability to identify and reject unqualified or excessively risky opportunities



Continuation after the introductory period is not automatic. The salesperson must demonstrate consistent effort, sound judgment, professional communication and the ability to build a credible pipeline of profitable opportunities.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word “PIPELINE” to confirm that you read the complete posting.



Please provide:



1. Your current résumé

2. Your experience selling to U.S.-based businesses

3. The products or services you have sold

4. Your average sale size and sales-cycle length

5. Your individual sales targets and actual results

6. Your largest personally originated and closed account

7. An example of a client you found through cold prospecting

8. Your experience with low-voltage, telecommunications, networking, field services or staffing

9. The prospecting and CRM tools you have used

10. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time

11. A short voice or video introduction demonstrating your spoken English

12. Two professional references who can verify your sales results



Applicants whose experience is limited to data entry, customer service, social-media posting or appointment setting without responsibility for developing and closing B2B opportunities will not be considered.

We are a leading US-based company in the custom-manufacturing industry and we're looking for driven individuals who OWNS IT, SERVE OTHERS, and want to build a long-term career - We offer more than just a job. We offer a place to grow. 



What You Can Expect:



Competitive pay with performance-based rewards (Build Financial Independence through your performance)

Stable, RECESSION-RESISTANT industry

PERMANENT work-from-home jobs

Opportunities to earn more through overtime (where applicable)

Clear CAREER GROWTH and ADVANCEMENT

Recognition based on results instead of seniority

Opportunities to take on new projects

I CANand I WILL attitude is rewarded

Learn, work and improve your skills from experienced and high-performing teams

Work with a company that uses cutting-edge technology

Join a collaborative and supportive culture



Be part of an INDUSTRY-LEADING and TECHNOLOGY-DRIVEN Company!



We are  looking for a driven and strategic Sales Manager to lead our sales team, accelerate revenue growth and build lasting customer relationships. 



It is time to showcase your leadership, analytics, and hands-on selling skills!



YOU will set the direction and help close key deals!



Our Sales Managers assist in hiring of a sales force team, training and retaining high quality tea
mber who exhibit our core values. Furthermore, coaches tea
mbers on the proper behavior needed to enhance customer service experience and drive sales results.



Must be experienced and have previous sales managerial expertise with results/performance of what has been accomplished in the past. 



Key Responsibilities: 



Lead and facilitate weekly sales and training meetings to align team goals and performance.

Develop and manage sales forecasts, tracking key performance metrics to ensure targets are met. 

Monitor and analyze sales turnover rates to optimize team effectiveness.

Ensures daily, weekly and monthly sales quotas are met by each tea
mber and sales team.

Utilizes sales/product training to keep sales team informed of product knowledge, selling skills and operational efficiencies.

Partners with HR Department to ensure proper staffing levels in sales positions and the development of tea
mbers.

Work closely with executive leadership to develop and implement sales strategies that improve product lines and enhance sales performance. 

Educates sales team by establishing training/programs of new account sales and growth, probability, improve presentation strategies, competitive strategies, proper use and level of sales support, management of profit/cost expense and execution of contracts.

Communication (telephone and
) presentation skills including telephonic, zoom and/or other devices and strong interpersonal, rapport building skills.

Foster a goal-driven, self-motivated sales culture, ensuring consistent follow-ups and accountability. 

Implement effective sales techniques and negotiation strategies to overcome objections and close deals.

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and overcome objections.

Create a Monthly Sales Plan to work with Sales Team and action plan to accomplish goal.

Review, analyze and act as needed for daily, week and monthly sales reports.

Ensure and attend to all incoming leads are worked and reported daily.

Perform random quality control evaluations with sales representatives.

Understand and help with investigation process.

Solid experience in opportunity qualification, pre-call planning, call control, account development, and time management.



Qualifications: 



2+ Years of Sales Managerial Experience

Proven track record of leading, developing, and retaining high-performing sales teams

Strong ability to read, write, and communicate effectively, both in written correspondence and presentations.

Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situation to customer and tea
mbers.

Proven experience in strategic and organizational development, including ability to attract, develop and retain.

Ability to prioritize and execute tasks efficiently in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. 

Ability to build a cohesive team and solve conflict among tea
mbers.

Proficient in business related technology systems.

Track record of servant leadership; serving others and putting team goals first.

Owners mindset; takes ownership over everything within scope of responsibility while still empowering others to do the same.

Adaptability; flexible to changing market forces and shifting priorities as needed.

Strong ability to simplify complex ideas and communicate them clearly to tea
mbers.

Demonstrate ability to drive results in the sales leadership role.

A passion for continuous learning and self-improvement, fostering the same mindset within the team.

Familiarity with CRM platforms.



System Requirements:



Computer Processor: Minimum 5th generation Intel i5 processor or equivalent

Computer Memory/RAM: Minimum 4.00 GB

Computer Operating System: Windows 10 or Mac OSX - No Linux, Unix or any operating system other than what is required.

Internet Speed: Running on a 5.0 MBPS plan or higher (Both primary and backup) - If your backup connection cannot serve as your primary connection, that does not qualify as a backup connection

REQUIRED – Headset: Noise-cancelling headset connected via USB port

REQUIRED – Web Cam: At least 3 megapixels capable of 720p recording



We’re picky. You must be smart, savvy, strategic, fun, and ready to learn fast and work hard. If you’re up for the challenge, we want to hear from you!



Click APPLY NOW and be one step closer to:



Competitive Commission Package

13th-Month Pay

Healthcare

One (1) Week Paid Vacation

Additional Incentives and Bonuses

An inspiring and fun work environment with endless career advancements and much more!

title: Real Estate Acquisition Specialist — Deal Sourcing + Calling + Follow-Up
description:

We are looking for someone with proven experience in real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, lead generation, cold calling, and deal sourcing who wants to build something long-term.



Your Role



You will help us:



Find off-market properties and motivated sellers

Research owners and potential investment opportunities

Build targeted lead lists

Perform skip tracing and property research

Call property owners

Qualify sellers and investment opportunities

Follow up with leads consistently

Handle SMS and
 follow-ups

Research comparable properties

Identify potential wholesale and fix & flip opportunities

Maintain our CRM and acquisition pipeline

Bring qualified opportunities to the team

Help move opportunities from lead ? conversation ? qualified deal ? offer

We're Looking For Someone Exceptional



You should already understand:



Real estate wholesaling

Fix & flips

Motivated sellers

Property research

Comparable sales

Basic deal analysis

Cold calling

Sales and objection handling

Lead nurturing

CRM management



We want someone who can think like an acquisition specialist, not simply follow a checklist.



If you see a property and think, “This could be a deal,” we want to know why.



Compensation



Competitive hourly rate based heavily on experience.



For the right person, we are willing to pay significantly more than a typical VA position.



There is also potential for:



Performance bonuses

Qualified-lead bonuses

Appointment bonuses

Closed-deal bonuses

Increased compensation as responsibilities and results grow



If you consistently help us find and close deals, your compensation will grow with your results.



Who We're Looking For



We want someone who is:



Extremely motivated

Excellent at communicating in English

Confident on the phone

Highly organized

Persistent

Analytical

Proactive

Competitive

Coachable

Interested in long-term success

Application — READ CAREFULLY



We are looking for experienced candidates, so please provide:



Your resume

Your real estate experience

Your previous acquisitions/wholesaling experience

Examples of deals or opportunities you personally helped generate

The markets you have worked in

The tools/CRMs you have used

Your expected compensation

A 90-second voice recording explaining why you believe you would be exceptional at this role



Start your application with “DEALMAKER”.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



We're looking for someone who wants to build a career, produce results, and grow with North Stone Capital Group.

Schedule daily jobs and crews in Jobber

Build efficient routes between jobs

Minimize unnecessary driving and wasted crew time

Coordinate schedules with field technicians

Communicate with customers by SMS, phone, and

Handle rescheduling, cancellations, and schedule changes

Confirm upcoming appointments

Communicate daily priorities with our team

Monitor job progress and make sure jobs are completed properly

Keep Jobber completely accurate and up to date

Review crew timesheets and identify excessive labor hours

Revenue per crew/day

Labor %

Hours worked vs. hours estimated

Revenue per labor hour

Job profitability

Drive/travel time

Schedule efficiency

Jobs completed

Cancellations/reschedules

Customer issues/callbacks

Crew productivity



Your job is to help us operate efficiently, protect our margins, and make sure every day is profitable.



What We're Looking For

Previous experience in operations, dispatch, scheduling, or home services

Excellent English communication

Extremely organized and detail-oriented

Strong problem-solving skills

Comfortable communicating with customers and employees

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Comfortable working with numbers and KPIs

Jobber experience is highly preferred

Experience with other CRM/scheduling software is a bonus

Able to work independently and take ownership

Strong sense of urgency and accountability

The Ideal Person



We don't want someone who simply waits for instructions.



We want someone who looks at the schedule and thinks:



“How can I make tomorrow more efficient?”



If a crew has three jobs in different areas, you should be thinking about routing, travel time, job duration, labor cost, customer availability, and profitability.



Compensation



$7–$12 CAN/hour depending on experience



Potential for increased compensation as responsibilities and performance grow.



How to Apply



Please send:



Your resume

Your operations/dispatch experience

Your experience with Jobber or similar software

Your expected hourly rate

A brief example of how you previously improved operational efficiency



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word “OPERATIONS”.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term and highly trusted member of our operations team.

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:

You’ll be working with artists and creative brands, producing content designed to stop the scroll and keep viewers watching.



Responsibilities



Edit vertical short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts



Create engaging hooks within the first 1–3 seconds



Add clean, readable, burned-in captions optimized for mobile viewing



Apply trend-aware editing styles (cuts, zooms, pacing, timing with music/audio)



Follow creative briefs, style guides, and templates



Stay updated on current viral trends and algorithm changes



Deliver consistent, on-time edits



Make revisions based on feedback



Required Skills



Proven experience editing short-form vertical video



Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts content styles



Familiarity with social media algorithms and viewer retention



Proficiency in CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro



Good communication skills



Reliable internet and availability for ongoing work



Nice to Have (Not Required)



Experience editing for musicians, artists, or creators



Knowledge of trending sounds, 
s, and formats



Understanding of hooks, CTAs, and watch-time optimization



Pay & Schedule



Competitive, based on experience



Paid hourly or per video (to be discussed)



Long-term work available for the right candidate



Flexible schedule, consistent workload



How to Apply (Important)



Please include:



3–5 short-form video examples you have edited



The software you use (CapCut, Premiere Pro, experience in both preferred)



A short answer to this question:

“What makes a short-form video go viral?”



Applications without examples will not be considered.

At R&J Agency, we help small and medium-sized businesses across the US upgrade their online presence. Our core service is building modern, high-converting business websites starting at $649, along with additional services like Website Care and Ad Creatives.



We do not hard-sell or push outdated sales tactics. Instead, we use a high-value "Free Demo" strategy: we show qualified business owners a custom, risk-free website preview before asking them to buy.



What We Offer (Compensation & Benefits)



Hourly Base Pay: $5.00 per hour worked (paid from Day 1).



High-Ticket Commission: 10% commission on all closed website sales.

Example: A standard $649 sale earns you $64.90. A $1,500 sale earns you $150.00.  



Trial Period (First 2 Days):You get paid $5/hour + 10% commission right away.  

Leads are 100% provided by us during your first 2 days so you can focus purely on calling, handling objections, and booking free previews.  



How the Role Works



Outreach & Prospecting: Contact US business owners (no website or outdated website). (Leads provided during trial; self-sourced after trial).  



Offer Value: Pitch a FREE, no-obligation website preview using our pre-built sector templates.  



Follow-Up & Close: Show the prospect their customized demo, demonstrate the business value, and close the sale.  



Handoff: Once the client pays, R&J Agency handles all technical delivery and onboarding.  



Requirements & Qualifications



Fluent Spoken English: Clear pronunciation, strong conversational flow, and professional tone.  



Sales Experience: Previous cold calling, B2B sales, or appointment setting experience is required.  



Natural Phone Presence: You don't read word-for-word from a script; you have natural conversations with business owners.  



Relentless Follow-Up: Strong discipline in keeping CRM notes and following up when promised.  



Equipment: Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a noise-canceling headset.



How to Apply

If you are a driven sales rep who wants a stable hourly base + uncapped commission potential, reply to this job post with: 



A brief introduction about your B2B sales/cold calling experience.



A link to a 1-minute voice recording (via Vocaroo, Google Drive, or Loom) introducing yourself. (Applications without a voice sample will not be reviewed).



Looking forward to bringing our next top closer onto the team!

title: Corporate Attorney
description:
The Company You’ll Join



OCD Anxiety Centers has a true passion for bringing help and hope to some of the most underserved clinical populations. We strive to change the lives of individuals and their families who have been suffering from unrelenting anxiety, disturbing and terrifying thoughts, uncontrollable worry, exhausting behaviors and rituals, and avoidance that keeps them from living their lives. We are an evidence-based practice, which means we do what works, we stay up to date with scientific research, and we regularly attend international training to keep us at our very best.



Our Investment in You



Competitive base salary



Quarterly performance bonus



Generous paid time off:



15 days PTO



5 paid sick days



9 paid holidays



401(k) with company match



Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with up to 80% of premiums covered by the company (varies based on coverage level)



HSA with company contribution



Tuition reimbursement and CEU support



Company-paid life insurance + voluntary supplemental options



Paid, specialized training from day one



Ongoing professional development and advancement pathways



The Team You’ll Work With



The success of our organization is dependent on the trust and confidence we earn from our employees, clients, and community. Our values are connected to our work at OCD Anxiety Centers and are measured against the highest possible standards of ethical business conduct.



We act with integrity and communicate honestly and openly



We are passionate about meeting the company’s needs and delivering for our clients



We are accountable for all our own actions



We work together as a team and are committed to excellence and innovation



We respect each other and celebrate our diversity



Purpose - The Corporate In-House Attorney provides legal guidance, contract support, regulatory interpretation, risk management, policy support, dispute resolution, and legal process discipline for a fast-growing behavioral health organization.



Key Performance Indicators and Reporting



Assigned contracts are drafted, reviewed, negotiated, or coordinated within approved turnaround standards and risk-priority levels.

Legal matter trackers, contract repositories, templates, outside counsel logs, and risk registers remain organized and review-ready.

Avoidable outside legal spend is reduced through appropriate internal handling and efficient outside counsel coordination.

Legal guidance is provided timely to leaders on contracts, employment, healthcare compliance, real estate, payor, privacy, and operational issues.

Policies, training, compliance readiness, and dispute prevention are supported through practical guidance.

High-risk legal matters are escalated with options, tradeoffs, recommended next steps, and documentation.

Upon achieving these key performance indicators, your supervisor will meet with you to review progress and collaborate on establishing new performance goals that reflect continued growth and excellence.



Core Competencies



Demonstrate strong role-specific knowledge, judgment, organization, and follow-through required for Corporate In-House Attorney.

Demonstrate clear communication, confidentiality, accountability, and ability to work in a fast-moving national organization.

Demonstrate ability to use data, systems, scorecards, and written documentation to make work visible and repeatable.

Demonstrate professional collaboration with leaders, peers, and cross-functional partners without creating duplicate ownership.

Demonstrate calm urgency, sound judgment, and willingness to escalate risks before they become larger problems.

Core Responsibilities - These duties may vary depending on job assignments and Company needs.



Primary Role Execution



Draft, review, negotiate, or coordinate review of contracts, leases, vendor agreements, payor agreements, and employment-related documents.

Maintain legal templates, approved clauses, contract playbooks, signature workflows, and risk escalation standards.

Advise leaders on contract obligations, notice deadlines, risk allocation, confidentiality, and termination rights.

Systems, Reporting and Quality



Coordinate with outside counsel for specialized matters, litigation, state-specific advice, or major transactions.

Support compliance, policy development, training, dispute response, and legal readiness for audits or diligence.

Maintain legal matter logs, outside counsel budgets, and executive status updates.

Cross-Functional Collaboration



Partner with assigned leaders and departments to keep handoffs clear, timely, documented, and aligned with Company priorities.

Maintain clean records, trackers, SOPs, reports, and communication trails that support audits, diligence, training, and continuity.

Escalate risks, unclear ownership, missing information, underperformance, compliance concerns, or client-impacting issues promptly.

Required Qualifications



Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school required.

Active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction required; Utah license preferred.

5+ years of legal experience preferred, including healthcare, corporate, employment, contract, compliance, or regulatory work.

Must pass all required background checks and meet Company, privacy, security, licensure, payer, or regulatory requirements applicable to the role.

Skills and Expertise



Contract drafting, negotiation, risk analysis, legal research, policy writing, dispute support, outside counsel coordination, and executive communication.

title: AI Video Scene Generator, OMNI Experience Required (Part-Time, Daily)
description:
Job description:

10-15 hours a week 

Need someone reliable to generate AI video scenes for me daily. This is a simple, repetitive job. I am not looking for a video editor or a creative.



IMPORTANT: You must have real hands-on experience with OMNI, including creating characters. This is required, not a plus. If you have never used OMNI, do not apply.



What I send you:



The exact prompt, written out and ready to paste

The starting frame image for each scene

Reference images and a spec for any character that needs to be created



What you do:



Create and save characters in OMNI from the references I send

Paste the prompt + starting frame into OMNI

Generate the scene

Check the output against a short list of things I don't want (blur, warping, wrong framing) and regenerate if it fails

Drop the finished clips into a shared Google Drive folder, named as instructed



What you do NOT do:



Write or change prompts

Design characters from scratch or make creative decisions

Edit, stitch, or trim anything

Add captions, text, music, or thumbnails



You will simply create the characters I spec out, generate scenes, put them in a folder and send them my way. Simple and easy.



Volume: 2-3 videos per day, every day. Each video is a handful of scenes. Expect roughly 1-2 hours of actual work daily once you're up to speed. Turnaround same day. Videos run 30 sec to 2.5 min.



Requirements:



Hands-on OMNI experience (required), including character creation. I will train you on my exact workflow, but I am not teaching you the tool from scratch.

Stable internet and a computer that can handle uploads/downloads all day

Comfortable with Google Drive

Detail-oriented. You follow file naming and folder structure exactly.

Responsive on
/WhatsApp during agreed hours



First batch is a paid trial to make sure we work well together. After that we can do a monthly retainer (part time) or a per video basis, your pick.



TO APPLY (read carefully, applications that skip this are ignored):



Start your message with the word BANANA so I know you read the post.

Tell me your rate. Quote it per month (part time) or per video, and tell me which.

Tell me what hours you're available in PH time.

Tell me how long you have been using OMNI, confirm you have created characters in it, and send 2-3 clips you generated with it. No OMNI samples, no reply.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer - TypeScript / Cloudflare Workers (Long Term, Claude Code)
description:
READ THIS FIRST.

Your application must open with these four lines, in this order. Anything that does not gets deleted unread.



Line 1 - A Cloudflare Worker enforces a rate limit by counting requests in a plain JavaScript Map declared at module scope. In production it lets through many times more requests than the limit allows. Why? One or two sentences.



Line 2 - Tell me about a time one customer could see another customer's data, either a bug you shipped or one you found in someone else's code. What the bug was, and what you changed so it could not happen again. If it has never happened to you, say so honestly.



Line 3 - A link to code you actually wrote. GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, a gist. Not a portfolio website, not a resume PDF.



Line 4 - How many hours per day you can overlap with Pacific time (Vancouver, UTC-7), and the monthly rate in USD you want.



THE PRODUCT

Alvero is a dental practice management platform I have been building. It is live and used every day by real clinics in Canada - staff portals, patient portals, scheduling, messaging, SMS and voice automation, and an integration with a legacy on-premise dental database. It is not a prototype and it is not a side project. When it breaks, a front desk cannot book a patient.



THE ROLE

I need one engineer to take it from where it is now to finished, and then keep it running. This is not a project with an end date. It is a job.



- Build the remaining features to launch quality

- Fix production issues, including the ones only one clinic ever sees

- Onboard new clinics onto the platform and sort out whatever breaks for them specifically

- Own the unglamorous parts: migrations, deploys, logs, alerts, dependency upgrades

- Write the small tools that stop the same problem coming back a third time



THE STACK

- TypeScript everywhere, strict mode

- React with Vite for the portals, some Next.js

- Cloudflare Workers, D1, KV, Pages, Wrangler

- Supabase and Postgres, row level security, multi tenant

- GitHub Actions for CI and deploys

- Twilio for SMS, Anthropic Claude API for the AI features

- I work on Windows and PowerShell, so scripts have to run there



You do not need every item on that list. You do need to be genuinely strong in TypeScript and SQL, and honest about the rest.



HOW I WORK

I use Claude Code every day and so will you. I am not looking for someone who pastes AI output and hopes. I am looking for someone who reviews it the way they would review a junior developer's pull request, and who can tell when it is confidently wrong. If you have never used an AI coding tool seriously, this is the wrong post for you.



Small changes, pull requests, no direct pushes to main. If you break production you tell me immediately, before I find out from a clinic. I would rather have boring code that works than clever code I get woken up for.



REQUIREMENTS

- 4 or more years writing production software, not tutorials and not agency landing pages

- TypeScript and SQL you can defend in a live conversation, screen shared

- You have carried something you built into production and supported it afterwards

- Full time, long term. I am hiring one person for years, not for one sprint.

- Written English good enough that your bug reports need no editing from me

- Reliable power and internet, and a machine that can actually run a dev environment



NICE TO HAVE

- Cloudflare Workers or another edge runtime

- Multi tenant SaaS, where one bad query leaks another tenant's data

- Healthcare, dental, or anything else with real privacy rules

- Integrating a legacy database nobody documented - ODBC, raw SQL, vendor APIs



HEALTH DATA

This platform handles patient information under Canadian privacy law. You will sign a confidentiality agreement. Development is done against synthetic data, never real patient records. If handling health information carefully sounds like an annoyance rather than part of the job, please do not apply.



PAY

1,800 to 2,600 USD per month, full time, depending on what you can actually do. Paid monthly, on time, reviewed at six months.



HOW HIRING WORKS

Applications that follow the four lines get read. Everything else is deleted. Shortlisted people get a short technical exercise, about 45 minutes, on a self contained problem - a piece of TypeScript to fix and a SQL question. Then a live screen share where you walk me through your own code.



Do not send me a generic cover letter. I have read hundreds of them.

title: PROFESSIONAL PHOTOSHOP EXPERT
description:
Kindly READ the job description.



We are looking for a highly skilled Adobe Photoshop expert with advanced-level experience in professional photo manipulation. This is NOT a beginner role and NOT for Canva users or basic graphic designers.



We need someone who can edit people and products at a professional, realistic level—the kind of work where edits are seamless, natural-looking, and indistinguishable from the original image.



REQUIRED SKILLS (ADVANCED ONLY)

You must be able to confidently and professionally perform the following:



• Place people into completely different photos or environments

• Retouch and edit faces while preserving natural likeness

• Remove, replace, or create realistic backgrounds

• Add or remove people and objects seamlessly

• Edit clothing, colors, accessories, and fine details

• Perform high-end retouching (skin, hair, lighting, shadows)

• Enhance and professionally edit product photos

• Place products into realistic lifestyle scenes

• Create high-quality composites using multiple images

• Match lighting, perspective, shadows, and color accurately

• Follow detailed instructions and reference images precisely



Resize and format images for:

• YouTube thumbnails

• Social media

• Websites

• Ads and marketing materials

• Print



STRICT REQUIREMENTS

• Advanced Adobe Photoshop skills ONLY (Photoshop must be your primary tool)

• NO Canva-only designers

• NO basic or entry-level editors

• Must understand professional compositing and photo manipulation techniques

• Must be able to produce high-quality, realistic results consistently



PORTFOLIO (REQUIRED – NON-NEGOTIABLE)

To be considered, you MUST submit a portfolio that includes:



• Before-and-after Photoshop work

• Face and appearance editing examples

• Background removal/replacement samples

• Photo manipulation involving people

• Product editing and enhancement

• Composite images using multiple photos



Applications without a portfolio will be ignored.



IMPORTANT NOTE

We are looking for someone who can deliver top-tier, professional Photoshop work. If you cannot confidently perform realistic photo manipulation at a high level, this role is not for you.

title: Full Cycle Construction Accountant (Advanced Excel skills REQUIRED)
