title: Trailer Management Admin (Urgent)
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Sunday - Friday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT | Tuesday - Sunday 10 AM - 8 PM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Hubstaff time tracking during shifts.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

This is NOT a general administrative VA position. Your main responsibility will be outbound calling, follow-up, appointment setting, lead research, and CRM/pipeline management.



What You’ll Do

Make outbound calls to U.S. healthcare facilities and businesses

Identify and reach the correct decision-makers, including discharge planners, case managers, social workers, administrators, transportation coordinators, directors, and business owners

Navigate receptionists and gatekeepers professionally

Research and verify contact names, phone numbers,
s, and roles

Ask questions to identify transportation problems, coverage gaps, overflow needs, and opportunities

Follow up consistently by phone and

Schedule qualified meetings for our NEMT clients

Document the exact outcome of every conversation

Update our CRM/Google Sheets with:

Contact name and role

Last outreach attempt

What the prospect said

Pipeline stage

Next action

Follow-up date

Escalate interested prospects and real transportation opportunities to our team

Attend pipeline review/training meetings as needed



Your Goal



Your job is not simply to make a high number of calls.



Your goal is to turn targeted healthcare accounts into:



Decision-maker conversations ? transportation needs identified ? qualified opportunities ? booked meetings



You are not responsible for negotiating or signing contracts. Our team and the local NEMT business owner will handle high-level sales conversations, pricing decisions, contracts, and service fulfillment.



Who We’re Looking For



You should have:



Excellent spoken and written English

Strong, clear phone communication

Previous cold-calling, appointment-setting, B2B sales, or lead-generation experience

Confidence speaking with U.S. businesses

Ability to navigate gatekeepers without sounding robotic

Experience calling hospitals, nursing facilities, medical practices, home care agencies, senior-care companies, insurance companies, or other healthcare organizations is a major plus.



Experience with HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Pipedrive, Google Sheets, or another CRM is also a plus.



Schedule

Part-time

Opportunity for increased hours and responsibility as the company grows

Compensation

Training



You will receive:

Outreach frameworks

Ongoing feedback on calls and messaging

title: Social Media Engagement Assistant
description:
About the Role

The Venue Playbook is a new education brand for wedding and event venue owners — templates, coaching, and courses built from real, working venue operations. We're launching the Instagram account from zero followers and need someone to handle the research and groundwork side of organic growth: finding the right people to connect with, and flagging where genuine engagement should happen — not writing or posting as the brand. The founder's own voice stays the founder's; this role finds the door, she walks through it.



This role starts scoped to Phase 1 only: engagement and research. It is not a content, copywriting, or community-management role at this stage. As the business grows, there's a defined Phase 2 this role can expand into — see Growth Path below. We're hiring with that trajectory in mind, but the day-to-day work starts, and stays, exactly as scoped in Phase 1 until the business is ready to expand it.

________________________________________

Daily Tasks — Phase 1 Scope

Each day, you'll build a shortlist of accounts and posts across a defined set of wedding-venue-industry hashtags and accounts, sorted into four action types:

1. Follow — accounts you've identified as real venue owners, coaches, or industry educators worth following. You can action these directly (no approval needed).

2. Like — posts worth liking to build presence in the niche. Also actionable directly.

3. Comment here — posts where a genuine, specific comment from the founder would land well. For each one, you'll flag why it's worth a comment in one line (e.g., "she's asking about deposit policies — founder has real experience here" or "new owner venting about vendor insurance, similar to an early struggle of ours"). You do not write or post the comment — you hand off the post and the reasoning, the founder writes the actual words.

4. Story-worthy — content worth reacting to or resharing in Stories, flagged the same way.



Deliverable: a short daily list (roughly 15–20 items total across all four categories) delivered by a set time each day, so the founder can move through it in 10–15 minutes rather than scrolling herself.



What makes something worth flagging (your judgment matters here):

• Real venue owners posting about their own operations — policies, wins, struggles — not couples' personal wedding accounts or adjacent vendors (photographers, florists, DJs).

• Posts with an actual hook to respond to — a question, an opinion, a pain point — not just a pretty photo with nothing to say.

• Active, recently-posted content from real accounts, not stale posts or engagement-pod content.

________________________________________

Hours & Schedule

Part-time to start: roughly 1.5–2 hours/day, 5 days a week (~8–10 hours/week). This can flex — if research on a given day turns up less, it doesn't need to be padded to fill time; if the niche is especially active, a bit more time finding quality over quantity is fine.



Timing is flexible day-to-day, but the daily list needs to land consistently at a set time each day so the founder can act on it before her own day fills up. Exact handoff time to be agreed during onboarding, ideally something that overlaps reasonably with US working hours for quick questions.

________________________________________

Access & Tools

• Access will be granted through Meta Business Suite as a collaborator with content/engagement permissions — never a shared password. This can be revoked cleanly if needed and keeps account security intact.

• Daily lists delivered via shared Google Sheet. 

________________________________________

Who Fits This Role

The founder's working style is high Dominance (40%) and high Compliance (36%), with low Influence (6%) and low Steadiness (18%) — direct, fast-moving, and detail-driven, with clear expectations and not much appetite for back-and-forth or reassurance-seeking. Practically, that means:

• Communicate in short, direct updates. Skip the preamble — lead with the list, the number, the flag. Long explanations or check-in questions where the answer is obvious will slow things down more than help.

• Work independently once the format is set. This role doesn't come with much day-to-day hand-holding — the founder will set clear expectations up front and expect consistent execution against them, not frequent clarification requests.

• Take direct feedback in stride. Feedback will likely be brief and to the point, not softened — the right person reads that as efficient, not personal.

• Bring the relational instinct the role needs, since the founder's own style is low on it. The actual task — sensing which post has a genuine, human moment worth commenting on — leans on social/relational read that isn't the founder's natural strength. A candidate with a warmer, more people-attuned style (even if the founder herself isn't) will likely spot better opportunities than someone purely mechanical about it.

• Steady, consistent follow-through matters more than charisma. The daily list needs to show up the same way, every day, without needing to be chased — reliability reads better here than personality.



In short: someone comfortable being told plainly what's needed and trusted to just do it — but who personally reads social nuance well, since that's the gap this role is filling.

________________________________________

Compensation & Structure

• Starting rate: $8.00–$8.50 USD/hour, based on experience.

• Pay schedule: Bi-weekly. 

o Work from the 1st–15th is paid on the 20th.

o Work from the 16th–30th/31st is paid on the 5th.

• Rate review: After an initial 60–90 day period, rate will be revisited based on performance and consistency. Room to grow for a candidate who proves out.

________________________________________

Growth Path — Phase 2 (Future, Not Immediate)

This role is scoped narrowly on purpose while the business is pre-launch. Phase 1 (engagement and research) is the entire job to start — there's no assumption the role quietly grows on its own. Expansion happens deliberately, once the business is ready for it, likely triggered by things like a growing follower base, launch of the course/coaching products, or simply the founder having validated the working relationship and wanting to hand off more.



When that point comes, Phase 2 could include:

• Scheduling and posting the content calendar

• Basic engagement reporting (what's working, follower growth trends)

• Eventually, more day-to-day social media management



Candidates interested in growing with the business over time are especially welcome — but should come in expecting Phase 1 as the real, ongoing scope, not a trial period for something bigger.

I’m looking for someone who genuinely enjoys **making another person’s life easier, more organized, and more efficient** - someone who notices loose ends, follows things through to completion, and continuously improves the systems around them.



The long-term goal is to build an increasingly effective **operating system for my professional and personal life**, so that less administrative work depends on me and more of my time is available for high-value work, health, relationships, and life.



## What You’ll Help Own



You will work across several businesses and areas of my personal life, including:



* Managing and organizing my
 inbox

 communication

, WhatsApp, and other channels

* Helping coordinate personal appointments, health-related scheduling and records, travel, reservations, events, purchases, and other life administration

* Researching options and bringing me concise recommendations

* Keeping recurring personal and business obligations organized

* Creating SOPs and systems for things we do repeatedly

* Using ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools to work faster and better

* Identifying repetitive work that can be automated, simplified, delegated, or eliminated

* Building or helping implement automations using Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar tools



## The Person I’m Looking For



The most important qualities are **ownership, organization, judgment, and follow-through**.



You should be someone who:



* Is extremely organized and conscientious

* Naturally follows up until something is actually completed

* Notices details other people miss

* Communicates clearly and comfortably

* Has excellent written and spoken English

* Is trustworthy and highly discreet

* Can manage multiple moving pieces without becoming overwhelmed

* Thinks ahead instead of waiting for instructions

* Enjoys creating structure from chaos

* Can prioritize what actually matters

* Is comfortable making recommendations

* Learns how I think and gradually handles more independently

* Enjoys technology, AI, systems, and efficiency

* Wants to improve processes rather than repeat inefficient ones forever



**Operations experience is a major plus.**



Experience supporting a founder, executive, physician, entrepreneur, or multiple businesses is also highly valuable.



## A Very Important Part of This Role



I do not want someone who finishes their task list and then waits for more work.



If everything assigned is complete, I want someone who naturally thinks:



**What are we waiting on?

What is coming up next?

What could fall through the cracks?

What can I organize now?

What can I simplify?

What are we still doing manually that could be automated?

What could I take off his plate next?**



That mindset matters more to me than knowing every software tool on Day 1.



## AI & Automation



You should already be comfortable with **ChatGPT and/or Claude** and interested in becoming significantly better with AI.



You may use AI for:



*
 drafting

* Research

* Summaries

* Document review

* Meeting preparation

* Organizing information

* Creating SOPs

* Comparing options

* Building workflows

* Creating reusable prompts and systems



Core Skills: Executive Assistance •
 Management • Calendar Management • Project/Operations Management • Google Workspace • Excellent English Communication • ChatGPT/AI. AI and specific skills for organizational software (Notion, Slack etc.) offer a strong advantage, but resourcefulness and willingness to learn are more important than knowing every platform.



## What Success Looks Like



Over time:



* I rarely need to monitor my own inbox

* My calendar and scheduling largely run without me

* Important follow-ups never depend on my memory

* My documents and administrative responsibilities stay organized

* You know what is happening across my different ventures

* You know what we are waiting for and proactively chase it

* Personal and professional obligations stop becoming last-minute emergencies

* You anticipate many needs before I ask

* Repetitive work becomes increasingly automated

* Our systems improve every month

* The amount of administrative noise reaching me continually decreases



Ultimately, I want you to become someone I trust to help **run the operating system around my life**, not simply someone I send tasks to.



## Compensation



**$7–$8 USD/hour depending on experience and capability**



* Full-time

* Long-term position

* Stable opportunity

* Eastern Time (US)



For the right person, I want this to become a role with increasing trust, responsibility, autonomy, and opportunity over time.



Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week. US Eastern time working hours. Typical schedule will include Monday - Friday with a shorter Saturday shift for planning, personal administration, systems improvement, and upcoming week preparation. All within the 40 hours. Exact schedule can be finalized with the right candidate.



## How to Apply



Please start your application with the word **LEVERAGE** so I know you read the entire posting.



Then answer these questions:



1. Tell me about the most demanding executive, founder, or business owner you have supported. What were you personally responsible for?



2. Imagine I want to stop routinely checking my own inbox. How would you gradually take ownership of it while making sure nothing important is missed?



3. Tell me about a time you noticed something needed to be done **without being asked** and took ownership of it.



4. What is one process you have improved, simplified, or automated? AI examples are welcome.



5. What AI tools and automation platforms do you currently use?



6. Imagine it is Friday afternoon. I have 15 unread important
s, three people who owe me documents, two appointments next week that still need coordination, and I haven't given you any new tasks today. Briefly tell me what you would do.





Please also include a **60–90 second video introduction**.



Please don't make the video overly formal or scripted. I want to understand how you communicate and whether we would enjoy working together every day.



I am looking for someone who wants to **grow with me for years**, become deeply trusted, and help create more order, simplicity, and leverage as my businesses and responsibilities continue to grow.

title: US Product Sourcing Specialist – Amazon FBA Private Label
description:
We are building an Amazon FBA private-label business and are looking for an experienced Product Sourcing Specialist to help us identify, evaluate, and develop reliable suppliers for products we have already researched and validated.



Our preference is for someone with strong experience sourcing from manufacturers and suppliers within the United States, ideally with an existing supplier network or proven methods for identifying qualified domestic manufacturers.



Key Responsibilities

•?  ?Source manufacturers, contract manufacturers, wholesalers, and suppliers for approved Amazon FBA product concepts.

•?  ?Prioritize U.S.-based manufacturers and suppliers whenever commercially viable.

•?  ?Identify multiple supplier options for each product rather than relying on a single source.

•?  ?Send RFQs and collect:

  * Unit pricing

  * MOQs

  * Sample costs

  * Production lead times

  * Packaging options

  * Private-label/custom-branding capabilities

  * Payment terms

  * Shipping and freight information



•?  ?Negotiate pricing, MOQs, payment terms, and other commercial terms.

•?  ?Verify supplier legitimacy, manufacturing capability, and relevant certifications.

•?  ?Coordinate product samples and communicate product specifications and required improvements.

•?  ?Compare suppliers based on quality, cost, reliability, lead time, and overall landed economics.

•?  ?Identify potential sourcing, compliance, quality-control, or supply-chain risks before orders are placed.

•?  ?Maintain clear supplier records, quotes, communication history, and sourcing comparisons.

•?  ?Work closely with our Amazon team to ensure sourced products meet required margins and Amazon FBA requirements.



You should have:



•?  ?Proven experience sourcing products for Amazon FBA and/or private-label businesses.

•?  ?Strong knowledge of U.S. manufacturers, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and distributors.

•?  ?Existing U.S. supplier/manufacturer contacts are highly preferred.

•?  ?Experience requesting and comparing supplier quotations.

•?  ?Strong negotiation skills.

•?  ?Understanding of MOQs, landed cost, freight, lead times, packaging, labeling, and private labeling.

•?  ?Experience evaluating supplier reliability and manufacturing quality.

•?  ?Familiarity with Amazon FBA product, packaging, labeling, and compliance requirements.

•?  ?Ability to communicate professionally with suppliers by
 and phone.

•?  ?Strong research, organization, and documentation skills.



Experience sourcing internationally is useful, but we are specifically looking for someone who can go beyond Alibaba and has substantial knowledge of the U.S. manufacturing and supplier landscape.



We will provide:

•?  ?Researched and pre-qualified product concepts

•?  ?Target selling prices

•?  ?Preliminary landed-cost ceilings

•?  ?Product specifications and improvement requirements

•?  ?Known customer complaints and quality issues to address

•?  ?Required sample and quality-control tests

•?  ?Guidance on which products should be sourced first



You will not be expected to randomly search for products to sell. Your primary responsibility will be turning validated product opportunities into qualified supplier options and commercially viable products.



The initial project will involve sourcing suppliers for a selected group of Amazon FBA private-label product opportunities. Strong performance can lead to ongoing sourcing and supplier-management work as the catalog expands.



Please include:

1.? ?A brief summary of your Amazon/private-label sourcing experience.

2.? ?Your experience specifically sourcing from U.S. manufacturers and suppliers.

3.? ?Examples of product categories you have sourced.

4.? ?How you typically find U.S. manufacturers beyond Google searches and Alibaba.

5.? ?Whether you already have an existing network of U.S. manufacturers or suppliers.

6.? ?An example of a sourcing project where you negotiated better pricing, MOQ, or terms.

7.? ?The tools or databases you use for manufacturer and supplier research.

8.? ?Your availability and preferred working arrangement.



Please begin your application with the words *“US SOURCING”* so we know you have read the full posting.

title: Transportation Tracker
description:

This role is ideal for someone highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast paced logistics environment where precision matters



Role Overview

As an Transportation Tracker, you will serve as a real time control point within route operations. Your responsibility is to ensure loads are properly assigned, tracked, updated, and documented while maintaining consistent communication across drivers, brokers, and customers. You will operate within structured SOPs while making fast, sound operational decisions when challenges arise.

• Track and update ETAs, check calls, timestamps, and delivery milestones in real time

• Communicate continuously with drivers, brokers, and customers regarding status updates

• Identify delays, route conflicts, detention risks, or service issues and take proactive action

• Escalate operational risks to leadership when necessary

• Generate shift based operational reports summarizing load activity and exceptions

• Follow dispatch, communication, and escalation SOPs consistently

• Maintain clean shift handoffs and organized documentation



What Success Looks Like

• TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms reflect complete and error free data at all times

• Scheduled updates are sent on time

• Critical loads are monitored closely and handled with urgency from start to finish

• Communication is clear, concise, and actionable, both in written updates and verbal escalations

• Operational risks and issues are flagged early with solutions, not just problems

• Shift handoffs are smooth, complete, and well documented

• You become someone the team can depend on during high pressure situations



Who We’re Looking For

• Has experience in logistics, freight brokerage, dispatch, or transportation tracking

• Understanding of fleet coordination, load planning, and HOS awareness

• Familiar with US geography and US logistics trucking operations (a plus)

• Ability to monitor multiple loads and drivers simultaneously

• Communicates clearly and professionally via zoom, chat, and

• Comfortable operating in high volume communication environments

• Follows instructions consistently and values clean execution

• Works well with a team and is open to feedback and coaching. Collaborates without resistance or ego



Why Join AJG Transport?

• Permanent remote opportunity

• Structured systems and clear expectations

• Hands on leadership and direct feedback

• Defined KPIs and measurable growth

• Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage

• Performance recognition and advancement potential



Schedule & Work Setup

title: Talent & HR Leader – Recruitment, Hiring, HR & Candidate Endorsement | Full-Time | Remote
description:
Talent & HR Leader – Recruitment, Hiring, HR & Candidate Endorsement | Full-Time | Remote

Location: Remote, Philippines-based preferred

Schedule: Full-Time

Work Hours: U.S. business hours

Compensation: $7-8+/hour, based on experience

Type: Long-Term | Full-Time



About the Role

We are looking for a strong Talent & HR Leader to lead recruitment, hiring, candidate endorsement, and HR/people operations for our Virtual Assistant workforce, especially healthcare-related roles. This is not just a recruiter role, and it's not just an HR role — it's both, combined into one seat. This person will own the full employee lifecycle: building strong talent pipelines, assessing candidate quality, endorsing candidates quickly and accurately, and then carrying that relationship forward through onboarding, employee relations, performance management, policy, and offboarding.



The ideal candidate has experience recruiting Virtual Assistants or remote talent and experience running HR functions for a remote or distributed team — policies, employee relations, performance, compliance — and can manage a disciplined process across both functions with clear metrics, strong follow-through, and high standards. This role requires someone who can balance speed with quality, and who can shift comfortably between hiring mode and people-management mode.



What You'll Own

Talent Acquisition & Hiring

- Recruit capable, culturally aligned Virtual Assistants based on client demand

- Build proactive talent pipelines for current and future roles

- Screen candidates for job capability, communication, professionalism, reliability, and culture fit

- Support hiring for key healthcare, dental, medical, orthodontic, administrative, client-facing, and operations roles

- Maintain strong candidate communication throughout the hiring process

- Negotiate, coordinate, and support hiring decisions as needed

Candidate Endorsement & SLA Management

- Ensure qualified candidates are endorsed to match client demand within required timelines

- Monitor endorsement timelines and intervene when candidates are at risk of missing deadlines

- Keep candidate movement organized and visible across the hiring pipeline

- Escalate stalled candidates, assessment concerns, or client-demand changes quickly

- Support smooth handoff from recruitment into onboarding or placement

HR & People Operations

- Own onboarding from offer acceptance through first 90 days, including documentation, account setup coordination, and orientation

- Serve as the primary HR point of contact for the VA workforce — answering policy questions, handling day-to-day employee relations issues, and escalating serious matters appropriately

- Maintain and evolve HR policies, employee handbooks, and standard operating procedures for a remote Philippines-based workforce

- Manage performance review cycles, PIPs, and documentation of performance or conduct issues

- Track and administer time-off, attendance, and any benefits or incentive programs

- Handle offboarding: exit conversations, knowledge transfer, access revocation coordination, and exit documentation

- Maintain accurate, compliant employee records

- Partner with leadership on compensation bands, promotions, and role changes

- Help build a strong internal culture, employee engagement practices, and retention initiatives across the VA team

Recruiting Operations & Process Improvement

- Manage and improve recruiting workflows, playbooks, templates, and SOPs

- Maintain accurate candidate records and pipeline updates in the ATS

- Use recruitment tools, dashboards, reports, and AI tools to improve hiring efficiency

- Identify bottlenecks in the hiring funnel and recommend improvements

- Standardize how candidates are screened, evaluated, endorsed, and handed off

Team Leadership & Coaching

- Coach recruiters and/or HR team members on screening quality, candidate communication, employee relations handling, and internal standards

- Review quality-of-hire concerns or culture/job-fit misses

- Support consistent evaluation and people-management standards across the team

- Lead with clear communication, accountability, and professionalism

Funnel Management & Reporting

- Review pipeline volume, funnel movement, and time-to-fill across open roles

- Track application volume, assessment pass rates, interview-to-offer conversion, and endorsement timelines

- Report hiring and HR metrics, risks, and recommendations to leadership (turnover, retention, time-to-fill, employee relations trends)

- Identify early patterns by role, client, cohort, source, or recruiter

Onboarding-to-Pool & Retention Support

- Own the full onboarding-to-tenure arc for newly hired VAs, not just the handoff

- Partner with VA Success and Client Success on early-tenure risks

- Monitor 90-day and long-term retention and early performance trends

- Identify whether hiring filters, sourcing channels, screening, or HR/onboarding processes need improvement

- Support long-term retention by improving both hiring quality and the employee experience from day one through tenure



Required Experience

- Experience in talent acquisition, recruiting leadership, or VA hiring

- Experience running HR functions — employee relations, performance management, policy, offboarding — ideally for a remote or distributed team

- Experience assessing both job capability and culture fit

- Strong understanding of high-quality candidate screening and evaluation

- Experience managing hiring pipelines and recruitment metrics

- Strong written and spoken English communication

- Strong judgment and decision-making skills, especially with sensitive employee matters

- Ability to coach recruiters and/or HR team members

- Strong documentation, follow-up, and reporting habits

- Comfortable working with U.S.-based clients, teams, or leadership

- Able to manage multiple open roles, HR cases, and competing priorities simultaneously

- Comfortable using an ATS or recruiting platform, plus HR/HRIS tooling



Healthcare Hiring Experience Preferred — Experience recruiting for healthcare, dental, orthodontic, medical, patient support, insurance, billing, administrative, or healthcare-adjacent roles is a plus. Understanding how to evaluate candidates for healthcare environments — communication, reliability, privacy awareness, documentation, professionalism, and patient/client service standards — is valuable.



What Success Looks Like

- Strong candidates are hired based on client demand and endorsed within required timelines

- Hiring pipelines are clear, active, and well-managed

- New hires have a smooth, well-documented onboarding experience

- Employee relations issues are handled promptly, fairly, and with proper documentation

- HR policies and processes are clear, consistent, and compliant

- Recruiters and/or HR team members are coached toward stronger performance

- Leadership has clear visibility into both hiring and HR metrics and risks

- Retention improves because candidates are better matched to the role and better supported once hired



To Apply

Please submit the following:

1. A viewable link to your updated resume

2. A short paragraph describing your experience with:

   - Recruiting or talent acquisition

   - VA or remote talent hiring

   - HR / people operations (employee relations, performance management, policy, offboarding)

   - Managing hiring pipelines or recruiting metrics



Subject Line: Talent & HR Leader – [Your Full Name]



We are looking for a Talent & HR Leader who can build a strong, scalable recruiting function while also owning the people side of the employee lifecycle — from first endorsement through long-term retention.

title: Full Time AI Community Newsletter Writer and Content Creator and Curator
description:
We are looking for a talented, dependable, and creative **AI Community Newsletter Writer and Content Curator** to join our team full time.



Our company manages several active communities focused on artificial intelligence, entrepreneurship, professional development, and business growth. We are not looking for someone who simply writes generic newsletters. We need someone who can enter our communities, identify the most valuable conversations, interview our members, review training content, and turn everything into newsletters people are excited to open and read.



You will manage up to **five weekly community newsletters and one daily newsletter**.



## What You Will Do



- Write, edit, format, and prepare engaging newsletters for multiple communities

- Review
 Groups, Skool communities, live training sessions, event recordings, Zoom calls, transcripts, and other community content

- Identify important discussions, questions, wins, announcements, resources, and opportunities that should be featured

- Interview community members, instructors, experts, team members, and special guests

- Prepare thoughtful interview questions before each interview

- Review interview recordings and transcripts and turn them into compelling newsletter stories

- Use AI tools to summarize, organize, repurpose, edit, and improve content

- Highlight and celebrate community member accomplishments, breakthroughs, testimonials, launches, promotions, and business wins

- Create educational newsletter sections that teach readers something useful

- Find and feature relevant opportunities such as grants, speaking opportunities, events, jobs, partnerships, tools, programs, and business resources

- Turn live trainings and long form content into short, clear, actionable newsletter content

- Write strong subject lines, headlines, introductions, calls to action, and community announcements

- Maintain the unique voice and personality of each community

- Coordinate with our team to collect information, confirm details, and meet publishing deadlines

- Maintain an editorial calendar for all newsletters

- Track upcoming events, deadlines, promotions, and important community dates

- Proofread every newsletter carefully before submission

- Recommend new newsletter sections, story ideas, engagement strategies, and content improvements



## What We Are Looking For



You must be an excellent writer and storyteller who knows how to make information clear, useful, interesting, and easy to read.



You must also be:



- Highly proficient with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms

- Experienced in using AI without producing robotic, repetitive, or inaccurate writing

- Comfortable creating prompts and AI workflows for research, writing, editing, summarizing, and repurposing content

- Skilled at interviewing people and asking questions that uncover meaningful stories

- Able to work from audio recordings, video recordings, transcripts, notes, and community conversations

- Experienced with
 Groups, Skool, or other online community platforms

- Excellent in written English, grammar, spelling, editing, and proofreading

- Able to capture someone else’s brand voice instead of writing everything in the same style

- Highly organized and capable of managing multiple newsletters and deadlines at the same time

- Proactive and able to identify great content without waiting for someone to assign every story

- Comfortable communicating with community members in a warm, professional, and respectful manner

- Able to verify names, dates, links, opportunities, and factual information before publishing

- Dependable, responsive, detail oriented, and committed to meeting deadlines



## Our Newsletter Philosophy



Our newsletters should make community members feel informed, valued, inspired, and connected.



Every newsletter should include a thoughtful combination of:



- Community member celebrations

- Educational tips and practical lessons

- Highlights from trainings and community conversations

- Important announcements and upcoming events

- Valuable tools, resources, and recommendations

- Relevant business, career, speaking, funding, partnership, or growth opportunities

- Clear next steps that encourage members to participate



We want our readers to finish each newsletter feeling like they learned something, discovered an opportunity, and became more connected to the community.



## Work Schedule



This is a **full time, long term position**.



You must be able to manage up to five weekly newsletters and one daily newsletter while maintaining excellent quality and meeting every deadline.



Some availability during United States business hours will be required for team meetings, interviews, and communication. The remaining work may be completed during your regular working hours in the Philippines.



## Performance Expectations



Your success will be measured by:



- Newsletters being completed accurately and on time

- Quality of writing and storytelling

- Ability to find valuable stories and opportunities

- Member engagement with newsletter content

- Accuracy of names, links, dates, and information

- Ability to maintain the voice of each community

- Strong organization and communication with the team

- Consistent use of AI to improve efficiency without lowering quality



## How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A short introduction explaining why you are a strong fit for this role

2. Links or attachments to two or three writing samples

3. An example of a newsletter you have written, if available

4. A description of the AI tools you currently use and how you use them

5. An example of how you would turn a one hour training or interview transcript into newsletter content

6. Your experience interviewing people or writing profile stories

7. Your expected monthly salary for a full time position

8. Your availability and preferred working hours in Philippine Time

9. The words **Community Newsletter Pro** at the beginning of your application so we know you read the complete job description



Applicants may be asked to complete a short paid writing test using a sample transcript or community discussion.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with our company, become deeply familiar with our communities, and help us create newsletters that our members genuinely look forward to receiving.

title: Sales & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Sales & Operations Virtual Assistant



Full-Time | U.S. Pacific Time



Are you a confident salesperson who can close deals AND take ownership of day-to-day operations?



SoCal Signature Clean is a rapidly growing premium cleaning company serving Southern California. We're looking for a sharp, ambitious Sales & Operations Virtual Assistant to become a key member of our team.



This is not a typical VA or customer service position.



We're looking for someone who can confidently speak with U.S.-based customers, turn inbound leads into booked jobs, solve problems without needing constant direction, and help ensure our daily cleaning operations run smoothly.



Your primary responsibility will be sales and converting inbound leads, but you'll also play an important role in operations, customer communication, scheduling, and social media.



If you're competitive, organized, dependable, and looking for a long-term opportunity where your responsibilities and income can grow with the company, we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do:



SALES & CUSTOMER GROWTH



* Answer inbound calls from prospective customers interested in our cleaning services

* Follow up aggressively and professionally with warm leads by phone, text, and

* Build rapport quickly with U.S.-based customers

* Understand each customer's needs and recommend the right service

* Explain our pricing and value confidently

* Handle objections related to price, scheduling, competitors, and trust

* Ask for the sale and confidently close customers over the phone

* Convert one-time customers into recurring weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly clients

* Follow up with past customers to generate repeat business and referrals

* Maintain accurate notes and follow-up tasks in our CRM



**There is no cold calling.** Most sales conversations will be with customers who have already expressed interest in our services.



DAILY OPERATIONS



You'll also help manage the day-to-day operations of our cleaning business.



This includes:



* Monitoring the cleaning schedule throughout the day

* Communicating with cleaners before, during, and after jobs

* Confirming that teams arrive on time and jobs are completed successfully

* Communicating schedule updates and instructions to customers and cleaners

* Helping resolve last-minute scheduling changes or operational issues

* Coordinating new bookings with cleaner availability

* Following up with customers after their cleaning

* Identifying problems before they become bigger issues

* Keeping our systems, schedules, and customer information organized



We don't want someone who simply waits to be told what to do. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, notices problems, and helps solve them.



SOCIAL MEDIA & ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT



As part of the role, you'll also help with:



* Posting and scheduling content across our social media accounts

* Responding to basic social media messages and inquiries

* Organizing customer photos and content

* Assisting with review generation and customer follow-up

* CRM updates and administrative tasks

* Helping with other projects as the company grows



Who We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate is:



*Excellent in spoken and written English

* Confident and natural speaking with American customers

* Experienced in phone sales, appointment setting, closing, or high-converting customer service

* Comfortable asking for the sale

* Strong at handling objections without sounding scripted

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Calm under pressure and good at solving problems

* Able to manage multiple conversations and priorities at once

* Dependable and punctual

* Self-motivated and comfortable working independently

* Coachable and interested in improving

* Comfortable being measured on performance and results

* Looking for a **long-term position**, not a temporary job



Experience working with a U.S.-based home service company is a major plus, but not required.



Technical Requirements



You must have:



* Reliable computer

* Wired high-speed internet connection of at least 30 Mbps

* Quiet, professional workspace with minimal background noise

* High-quality headset and microphone

* Backup internet connection

* Backup computer/device in case of emergencies



Because this position involves answering live inbound sales calls, reliable internet and attendance are extremely important.



Compensation



Starting Pay: $5.00 USD/hour - 40 hours per week



PLUS:



* Uncapped sales commissions

* Performance bonuses

* Opportunities for raises based on performance

* Opportunities for increased responsibility and advancement as the company grows



We want someone who is motivated by results. Strong performers will have the opportunity to earn significantly more than their base hourly pay.



Schedule



* Full-time position

* Must be available during U.S. business hours

* Schedule will follow Pacific Time (California)



Please make sure you're comfortable working these hours from the Philippines before applying.



Why Join SoCal Signature Clean?



We're building a company, not just filling a VA position.



You'll have the opportunity to:



* Join a growing U.S.-based company

* Work with warm inbound leads instead of cold calling

* Earn additional income through sales commissions and performance bonuses

* Develop skills in sales, operations, customer experience, and business management

* Take on more responsibility as you prove yourself

* Grow into a leadership position as our team expands

* Directly impact the growth and success of the company



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us for years, not months.



How to Apply



*Applications without a recording will not be considered.*



Please submit a 1–2 minute video or audio recording introducing yourself and answering the following:



1. Tell us about your previous sales experience.

2. Why are you interested in joining SoCal Signature Clean?



Please also include your resume



We're excited to meet you!

title: Marketing Project Manager — Real Estate Dubai Market · Fully Remote
description:
About us



IMSOLD Agency is the agency arm of an AI-first venture studio. We don't run campaigns for clients and

hand over a report — we build and operate brands end to end: research, creative, funnels, media

buying, tech, and the teams that run them. Our portfolio spans health, wellness, B2B software, and

real estate across the US, Europe, and the Middle East.

This role sits on our Dubai real estate lead-generation account — a fast-moving operation

connecting property owners and investors with licensed Dubai real estate professionals.



About the role



You orchestrate the complete marketing flow of the brand — from verified research foundations to a

running content calendar — then hand off to production, which runs on our proprietary operations

platform.

You do not produce the work. Specialist teams handle research, copywriting, design, video, publishing,

and legal review. Your job is rather: to see the whole machine, verify that every input exists and is

sound before work starts, spot the missing dependency before it breaks something downstream, and

keep a dozen specialists in time. Six verbs describe the day-to-day: verify ? chase ? assemble ?

agree ? build ? hand off.



What you'll do



Verify the brand's marketing foundations — market and competitor research, audience definitions,

messaging inputs, legal constraints — and trigger the right specialist team when a layer is missing

or below the bar

Assemble all verified inputs into one content plan for the brand

Agree the content rhythm — channels, campaign mix, volume — directly with the brand's

leadership

Build the content calendar so that every slot has its creative, caption, call-to-action, and a

destination that actually exists

Hand off cleanly to production and keep the machine flowing: chase blockers, reconcile numbers,

route every creative through compliance review before launch

Quality-control what comes back: catch contradictions, impossible numbers, and unsourced claims

before they reach anyone downstream



What we're looking for



3+ years running performance-marketing, direct-response, or growth projects — owning the

system, not just executing tasks in it

Hands-on familiarity with paid social funnels (Meta especially): you don't have to be the media

buyer, but you must understand CPMs, CTR, CPL, and funnel math well enough to manage one

Proven ability to orchestrate a team of specialists to ship on deadline — and to tell someone their

work is broken when it is

An instinct for dependencies: you naturally order work by what must exist first, and you treat

"done" as something to verify, not something to accept

Fluent, precise written English — this is an async, remote, documentation-heavy environment



Real estate experience — a strong plus



Dubai / UAE property market experience

You've marketed in or to the Dubai real estate market — brokerage marketing, property portals or

proptech, developer marketing, or lead generation for UAE realtors — and you know its

advertising rules and market dynamics first-hand.



Property-market experience anywhere

You've run marketing operations or lead generation in any serious property market. The instincts

transfer; the Dubai specifics are teachable.



What this role is not



Not a real estate sales role — no transactions, no client calls, no commissions

Not a content-production role — you won't write scripts, design, or edit video

Not a media-buying role — specialists run the ads; you run the flow



What we offer



Fully remote work with high autonomy and high standards — you'll be trusted to run things, and

held to the results

A documented, systemized operation: you inherit a complete written playbook, not chaos

Exposure to a multi-brand venture studio and a modern AI-native marketing stack

Long-term growth: strong moderators take on additional brands across the portfolio



How to apply



Send your CV to 
 with the subject line "Marketing Project Manager — Real

Estate" and include, in the body of your message:



In exactly five sentences: describe one system or process you personally kept on the rails —

what its moving parts were, what broke most often, and how you caught it early

Your real estate / Dubai market experience, if any (be specific — markets, companies, campaigns)

Your monthly salary expectation and earliest start date



Applications that skip the five-sentence answer will not be reviewed — following the instruction is part of the test.

Shortlisted candidates complete a recorded 20–25 minute first-line interview conducted by our AI interviewer, followed by

a live assessment session and a paid trial task.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — TikTok, YouTube Shorts & Instagram Reels
description:
We are looking for a **Short-Form Video Editor** to join our content team and help grow our social media presence across **YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels**.



### Job Details



**Niche:** Forex Trading, Investing & Financial Education

**Content:** TikTok, YouTube Shorts & Instagram Reels

**Volume:** Approximately **28 short-form videos per month**

**Content Breakdown:**



* ~24 clips repurposed from long-form YouTube content

* ~4 original personality/strategy clips

  **Video Length:** Generally 20–60 seconds

  **Turnaround:** 24–48 hours per batch/video depending on workload

  **Rate:** **$3 per finished short**, depending on complexity

  **Duration:** Long-term relationship



Hey there! Thanks for checking out our job post.



I'm looking for a short-form editor who understands that creating Shorts isn't just about cutting a long video into vertical format.



The goal is to create **scroll-stopping content that grabs attention quickly, keeps viewers engaged, and ultimately drives people toward my YouTube channel.**



My channel focuses on forex trading, swing trading, market analysis, trading psychology, educational content, and trading challenges.



I'm looking for someone who understands **hooks, pacing, retention, captions, storytelling, and short-form content trends.**



I'm not looking for overly flashy edits just for the sake of being flashy. I want the editing to feel modern, engaging, clean, and natural while still giving viewers a reason to keep watching.



## Content Strategy



The monthly workflow will consist of approximately **28 Shorts**:



### 1. Long-Form Repurposing — ~24 Shorts



I will provide long-form YouTube content that can be turned into multiple short-form clips.



You should be able to identify the strongest moments, hooks, lessons, opinions, or entertaining sections and turn them into standalone Shorts.



The clips should make sense **without requiring someone to watch the full YouTube video first.**



### 2. Native Short-Form Content — ~4 Shorts



These will be specifically recorded for short-form content.



These may include:



* Trading tips

* Strategy explanations

* Trading psychology

* Quick market insights

* Personal opinions

* Personality-driven content

* Educational concepts



These should feel native to TikTok/Reels/Shorts rather than simply feeling like shortened YouTube videos.



## Responsibilities



* Turn long-form YouTube content into engaging short-form videos

* Identify strong moments and potential hooks

* Create compelling openings within the first few seconds

* Remove unnecessary pauses, filler words, and dead space

* Add clean, engaging captions

* Highlight important words or phrases

* Use zooms, cuts, B-roll, sound effects, and motion graphics when appropriate

* Reframe footage properly for **9:16 vertical format**

* Maintain strong pacing throughout the video

* Make educational content easy to understand

* Create edits that feel native to TikTok, Shorts, and Reels

* Add subtle visual effects that improve retention without becoming distracting

* Include a CTA toward the YouTube channel when appropriate

* Maintain consistent branding across all short-form content



## What I'm Looking For



The ideal editor understands:



**HOOK ? VALUE ? RETENTION ? CTA**



You should know how to take something like:



> "Here's something most beginner traders don't understand..."



and turn it into an opening that makes someone want to keep watching.



I'm looking for someone who can recognize the **most interesting part of a conversation or lesson** and build the Short around that moment.



## Editing Style



I want the content to feel:



* Clean

* Modern

* Engaging

* Fast-paced when appropriate

* Easy to follow

* Personality-driven

* Professional

* Native to short-form platforms



I don't want every second filled with effects.



**Good pacing and storytelling are more important than excessive effects.**



Captions should be visually engaging but still easy to read.



## Requirements



* Previous experience editing TikTok, Instagram Reels, and/or YouTube Shorts

* Strong understanding of short-form audience retention

* Ability to create strong hooks

* Experience with captions and on-screen text

* Understanding of 9:16 vertical video

* Experience with Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar software

* Strong communication skills

* Reliable turnaround times

* Fluent or advanced English

* Willing to accept feedback and continuously improve

* Ability to identify strong moments from long-form content independently



## Bonus



You will stand out if you:



* Have experience editing content in the **finance, trading, investing, or educational niche**

* Understand trading terminology

* Have experience growing short-form content

* Understand TikTok/Instagram/YouTube Shorts trends

* Can suggest better hooks or ways to structure a clip

* Understand how to create content that funnels viewers toward long-form YouTube videos

title: Community Research & Engagement  Specialist
description:
Community Research & Engagement Specialist — Reddit

Remote — Philippines

Part-Time: 10–15 hours/week

$5 - 7  USD/hour depending on experience

This isn't a typical social-media job.

We're a growing U.S. oral-health and wellness company looking for someone who is exceptionally curious about people and the questions they ask online.

Every day, thousands of people go online worried about their health.

They're scared. They're confused. They're embarrassed to ask a question. Sometimes they simply want someone to explain something in a way they can understand.

We want to listen to them and help.

Your primary focus will be Reddit.

You'll find real conversations about oral health, gum disease, bleeding gums, dental anxiety, dental cleanings, bad breath, oral bacteria, saliva and other oral-health concerns.

But we don't just want to know what they're asking.

We want to understand why they're asking it.

Your Job

You'll spend approximately 10–15 hours each week:

Searching Reddit for relevant conversations and questions

Reading and understanding what people are worried about

Identifying the question behind the question

Categorizing questions, fears and recurring themes

Researching credible information

Drafting warm, thoughtful responses

Tracking conversations in Google Sheets

Following responses and identifying new questions

Preparing a short weekly report about what you're learning

What You Will NOT Do

This is extremely important.

You will not spam Reddit.

You will not copy and paste promotional messages.

You will not pretend to be a customer.

You will not secretly promote our company.

You will not diagnose anyone or give individualized medical treatment advice.

And you will not try to turn every conversation into a sale.

Our philosophy is simple:

Listen first.

Understand second.

Help third.

Marketing comes much later.

Who We're Looking For

You may be a great fit if:

Your written English is exceptional

You understand natural American conversation

You're empathetic and emotionally intelligent

You're naturally curious

You're a strong internet researcher

You can distinguish credible information from questionable claims

You are comfortable using Google Sheets

You understand Reddit culture—or are willing to learn it

You can write like a human, not a corporate marketing department

You know when a question should be escalated rather than answered

Healthcare, dental, wellness, research, customer-service or community-management experience is helpful but not required.

We're much more interested in how you think and communicate.

HOW TO APPLY

Please don't send us a generic cover letter.

Instead, answer these three questions:

1. Someone posts on Reddit:

"I brush twice a day and floss. My dentist just told me I have gum disease. How is that even possible? I'm really upset."

Write exactly how you would respond.

2. Someone posts:

"I haven't been to the dentist in eight years because I'm terrified they're going to judge me. I know I need to go, but I can't make myself do it."

Write exactly how you would respond.

3. Someone asks you a health question and you're not confident that you know the correct answer.

What would you do?

Finally, begin your application with the words:

I READ THE ENTIRE POST

Applications that don't include those words will not be considered.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just see a Reddit post.

We want someone who sees the person behind it.

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Sunday - Friday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT | Tuesday - Sunday 10 AM - 8 PM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

What You'll Get

title: Help Wanted: Senior GoHighLevel (GHL) /Claude/ Automation
description:
Warning: This is not a role for beginners. We use a strict 15-point technical rubric to screen all applicants.



***MUST HAVE PREVIOUS EMPLOYER REVIEWS**** NO REVIEWS DONT APPLY 



Are you a true GoHighLevel master who lives and breathes workflows, snapshots, and SaaS mode? We are looking for a highly technical, strategic GoHighLevel Expert with a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience to lead our platform architecture, client onboarding, and complex automation builds.



If you know the difference between a trigger link and a custom value, understand how to build scalable snapshots, and can troubleshoot A2P 10DLC compliance in your sleep, we want you on our team.



The Role



As our Senior GHL Expert, you will be the technical backbone of our CRM and marketing automation operations. You will not just be building basic funnels; you will be architecting complex, multi-step workflows, integrating third-party tools via webhooks and APIs, and ensuring our white-labeled SaaS offering runs flawlessly for our clients.



You will take ownership of the entire GHL ecosystem, from initial sub-account setup and domain configuration to deploying advanced AI chatbots and database reactivation campaigns. We need a problem-solver who can translate business goals into seamless, automated technical solutions.



Key Responsibilities



We expect our GHL Expert to handle high-level technical execution and strategic planning. Your primary duties will include:



Platform Architecture & Snapshots: Designing, building, and maintaining master snapshots that can be deployed across dozens of client sub-accounts. You will utilize custom values, custom fields, and smart lists to ensure scalable, error-free onboarding.



Advanced Automation & Workflows: Architecting complex workflows for lead nurturing, appointment booking (round-robin and collective), missed call text-back, and automated review requests. You must be proficient in using if/else logic, wait steps, and inbound/outbound webhooks.



Technical Setup & Compliance: Managing the unglamorous but critical backend tasks. This includes configuring LC
/Mailgun, LC Phone/Twilio, domain DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and ensuring strict adherence to A2P 10DLC SMS compliance.



Funnels & Integrations: Building high-converting, two-step sales funnels and landing pages. You will also connect GHL to external platforms using Zapier, Make (Integromat), Pabbly, or native APIs to ensure data flows seamlessly between systems.



How to Apply (The 15-Point Test)



We do not want generic cover letters. To apply, you must answer this single question:



"Explain the most complex workflow or snapshot you have ever built. Include specific details about the triggers, actions, and integrations you used."



We will score your answer using our internal 15-point rubric:



•

0-5 Points for Complexity: Are you building basic auto-responders, or advanced multi-step logic with if/else conditions and round-robin routing?



•

0-5 Points for Terminology: Do you use specific GHL terms correctly (Custom Values, Inbound Webhooks, LC
), or generic marketing fluff?



•

0-5 Points for Integrations: Can you connect GHL to the outside world using Catch Hooks, JSON payloads, or native APIs?



Note: If you mention the legacy "Triggers" tab, or if you tell us you use ClickFunnels and ActiveCampaign instead of building natively in GHL, your application will be instantly rejected.



If you score a 12 or higher, we will contact you immediately for a live technical interview.



Please submit your resume and your technical answer to

About REMBOX

REMBOX is an international architectural and engineering company serving as a strategic partner for leading design organizations in Israel and the United States. With over 500 professionals across four offices in Belarus, REMBOX is launching its Philippines entity in October 2025 as part of its global expansion strategy. This role involves managing ongoing corporate administrative and compliance requirements, full-cycle HR administration and record keeping, and processing monthly payroll from scratch. You will own entity registration, corporate administration, HR documentation, record management, and payroll – excluding performance management, recruitment, and employee engagement. You will work closely with the CEO to ensure a successful October 2025 launch.



Key Responsibilities

Entity Registration & Government Compliance

Lead the full company registration process with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) via eSPARC, including Articles of Incorporation, By-laws, and all required documentation.

Handle Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) registration, including BIR Form 1903, books of account, and authority to print official receipts and invoices.

Secure all local government unit (LGU) permits and clearances, such as barangay clearance, mayor's permit, fire safety clearance, and zoning clearance.

Open and manage the corporate bank account in coordination with the CEO.

Coordinate with legal counsel, notaries, and government liaison officers as needed.

Monitor and track all registration timelines and deadlines to ensure the October 2025 entity launch target is met.

Manage annual compliance requirements, such as SEC annual reports (GIS), BIR annual filings, and LGU permit renewals.

Prepare and file required government reports and disclosures on time.

Coordinate with external accountants, auditors, and legal counsel for ongoing compliance.

Draft and manage corporate documents, including board resolutions, secretary's certificates, and authorization letters.

Build and maintain a compliance calendar to track all filing deadlines across agencies.



HR Administration & Record Keeping

Maintain complete, accurate, and organized employee records (201 files, contracts, government IDs, SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG numbers, TINs, and employment history).

Manage employee onboarding administration, including government number registration, requirements collection, and contract preparation under legal counsel direction.

Draft and maintain employment contracts, B2B contractor agreements, and offer letters in compliance with Philippine labor law and under legal counsel guidance.

Maintain a leave management system to track leave credits, absences, tardiness, and time off.

Manage employee timekeeping and attendance tracking for accurate payroll processing.

Process and record government-mandated benefits claims (SSS sickness/maternity/disability, PhilHealth reimbursements, Pag-IBIG loan applications).

Handle employee offboarding administration, including clearance processing, final pay computation, BIR Form 2316 preparation, and government number deregistration.

Maintain a central, organized, and version-controlled HR document repository.

Ensure compliance with DOLE reporting requirements and labor law standards.

Keep an updated organizational chart and employee directory.



Payroll Management

Set up and manage the full payroll process for REMBOX Philippines from scratch, including computation, payslip generation, and salary disbursement.

Process monthly payroll accurately and on time, including basic pay, allowances, overtime, holiday pay, and deductions.

Manage statutory contributions and remittances (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG) for all employees accurately and on time.

Handle BIR tax compliance related to payroll, including withholding tax on compensation (BIR Form 1601-C) and year-end BIR 

Form 2316 preparation and filing.

Maintain accurate payroll records, payslip history, and employee compensation schedules.

Coordinate with external accountants or payroll service providers as needed.



Executive Support (CEO)

Serve as the primary point of contact for all corporate admin and compliance matters, reporting directly to the CEO.

Provide regular status updates on registration progress, compliance deadlines, and corporate admin tasks.

Coordinate meetings, government appointments, and notarial services as required.

Handle confidential corporate documents with discretion and professionalism.



Registration Process Overview

The candidate must be fully capable of managing the following registration sequence end-to-end:

| 1 | SEC | Company name reservation, Articles of Incorporation, By-laws, Treasurer's Affidavit, eSPARC online filing, Certificate of Incorporation |

| 2 | Corporate Bank | Open corporate bank account, deposit paid-up capital, obtain bank certificate |

| 3 | BIR | BIR Form 1903, books of account registration, authority to print receipts and invoices, TIN issuance |

| 4 | LGU | Barangay clearance, mayor's permit, fire safety clearance, zoning clearance |

| 5 | SSS / PhilHealth / Pag-IBIG | Employer registration with all three statutory agencies prior to first hire |

| 6 | Ongoing compliance | SEC GIS annual report, BIR annual filings, LGU permit renewals, corporate records maintenance 



Must-have

Proven experience managing Philippine company registration (SEC, BIR, LGU, SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG).

Hands-on payroll management experience, including payroll computation, payslip generation, statutory remittances, and BIR withholding tax compliance.

Strong knowledge of the Philippine Labor Code, DOLE regulations, and HR compliance requirements.

Experience managing employee records (201 files), leave tracking, timekeeping, and HR documentation.

Experience handling government-mandated benefit claims (SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG).

Experience processing employee offboarding, including clearance, final pay, and BIR Form 2316.

Strong knowledge of Philippine corporate law, SEC regulations, and BIR compliance requirements.

Experience with the SEC eSPARC online registration system.

Ability to work directly with and report to C-level executives.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple processes simultaneously.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Background in corporate law, accounting, or business administration.
