description:
# Social Media & Marketing Manager — Aesthetics Clinic & Academy



We are looking for a reliable, creative and proactive **Social Media & Marketing Manager**, preferably with previous experience or strong knowledge of the **aesthetics, beauty, skincare or cosmetic treatment industry**.



You will be responsible for growing the online presence of both our **aesthetics clinic and training academy**, attracting new clients and students, promoting our treatments and courses, and building awareness within London.



**Pay:** $250 USD every 2 weeks

**Posting:** 7 days per week

**Daily posting deadline:** Content must be live by **5–6 PM UK time**



## Platforms



* Instagram

* TikTok

*

* YouTube Shorts

* WhatsApp Status

*

* Nextdoor/local community platforms

* Relevant London
 groups and communities



## Full Responsibilities



### Social Media Management



* Manage the clinic and academy's social media accounts across all required platforms.

* Create, plan and maintain a consistent weekly/monthly **content calendar**.

* Ensure agreed daily content is published by **5–6 PM UK time**.

* Adapt content appropriately for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, YouTube Shorts, 
 and
 rather than simply uploading identical posts everywhere.

* Write engaging captions, hooks, calls-to-action, hashtags, titles and descriptions.

* Schedule content in advance whenever possible.

* Maintain a professional and consistent brand image across all platforms.



### Aesthetics Clinic Marketing



* Create and promote content around our aesthetic treatments and services.

* Understand how to market an aesthetics clinic professionally and responsibly.

* Turn treatment footage, educational information, FAQs, client-approved content and clinic footage into engaging social media content.

* Develop content designed to turn followers into genuine enquiries and bookings.

* Create educational content that builds trust and demonstrates the clinic's expertise.

* Help promote new treatments, special campaigns and clinic announcements.

* Ensure treatment-related marketing is accurate and avoids misleading or inappropriate claims.



### Academy & Course Marketing



* Promote our aesthetics training courses and academy.

* Create content aimed at potential students who are interested in entering or developing within the aesthetics industry.

* Promote upcoming training dates and course availability.

* Showcase appropriate behind-the-scenes training content and student experiences where permission has been obtained.

* Create educational posts explaining courses, training opportunities and what students can expect.

* Help generate enquiries and potential student leads through social media.



### London Community Promotion



* Research and join relevant **London
 groups and local online communities**.

* Engage genuinely with local discussions and identify appropriate opportunities to introduce our clinic or academy.

* Promote the business in groups where business advertising is permitted.

* Manage and promote the business through **Nextdoor and other suitable local community platforms**.

* Identify posts from people looking for relevant aesthetic services or training and respond appropriately.

* Keep a record of groups and communities being used and which ones generate enquiries.

* Never spam groups or post advertisements where promotional content is prohibited.



### Community Management



* Monitor comments and social media engagement.

* Respond professionally to general enquiries within agreed guidelines.

* Flag important, sensitive or treatment-specific questions to the clinic rather than giving medical advice.

* Encourage appropriate engagement with followers and potential clients/students.

* Help develop an active local community around the clinic and academy.



### Content Creation & Editing



* Perform basic editing of Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts.

* Add appropriate subtitles, text, hooks and calls-to-action to videos.

* Create simple social media graphics and promotional material when required.

* Organize raw videos, edited videos, photos, graphics and completed posts within **iCloud**.

* Maintain clearly labelled folders so content can easily be found and reused.



### Growth & Strategy



* Develop separate social media strategies for the **clinic** and **academy**.

* Research aesthetics and beauty trends that could be relevant to our audience.

* Monitor competitors, particularly successful aesthetics clinics and academies in London.

* Research trending content formats, hooks and ideas.

* Suggest new campaigns and content ideas rather than waiting to be told what to post.

* Focus on meaningful results such as enquiries, bookings and academy leads—not only followers and likes.



### Analytics & Reporting



* Provide a **daily analytics screenshot** showing performance.

* Track reach, views, engagement, follower growth, enquiries and other relevant metrics.

* Provide a simple **weekly performance summary** explaining:



  * Best-performing content

  * Lowest-performing content

  * Follower growth

  * Reach and engagement

  * Enquiries/leads generated

  * What should be changed or tested the following week

* Use performance data to continually improve the content strategy.



## Must-Have



* Previous social media management experience.

* **Knowledge or experience within aesthetics, beauty, skincare, cosmetic treatments or a closely related industry is strongly preferred.**

* Good understanding of Instagram, TikTok,
 and short-form video.

* Strong written English and copywriting ability.

* Ability to create strong hooks, captions and calls-to-action.

* Basic short-form video editing skills.

* Understanding of social media analytics.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Reliable enough to maintain a **7-day-per-week posting schedule**.

* Ability to work independently without needing daily reminders.

* Own computer/phone and reliable internet connection.



## Preferred Experience



* Previous work with an **aesthetics clinic, beauty clinic, cosmetic treatment provider or aesthetics academy**.

* Understanding of how to market treatments while keeping advertising accurate and responsible.

* Experience generating local leads for London businesses.

* Experience marketing training courses or educational businesses.

* Experience with Meta Business Suite and social scheduling tools.

* Experience growing a clinic or beauty brand's social media presence.



## What We Expect



We don't want someone who simply uploads the content we send them.



We are looking for someone who can **think strategically, bring us ideas, understand the aesthetics industry, identify opportunities to promote the clinic and academy, and actively work towards generating more enquiries, bookings and students.**



Reliability, consistency and communication are extremely important.

title: Business & Commercial Representative – Attend Meetings & Close Deals | Web3 & iGaming | Philippines | Female Preferred

Title:

Remote KOL Commercial Representative – Attend Meetings & Close Deals | Web3 & iGaming | Philippines | Female Preferred



————————————————————————



About us



We are a growth company in Web3 and iGaming / Slot. We work with global KOLs, MCNs, agents, and affiliate partners.



Our internal team will handle:

• KOL research and screening

• Initial outreach

• Scheduling commercial meetings (calls / video meetings)



We are hiring one person whose main job is to ATTEND these meetings ON BEHALF OF OUR COMPANY and negotiate until all cooperation details are agreed.



————————————————————————



Your main job



When our team books a commercial meeting with a KOL, agent, or MCN, you will:



1. Join the meeting on time (video or voice)

2. Represent our company professionally

3. Present the campaign proposal we provide

4. Negotiate all commercial terms, including:

   - Price / rate

   - Deliverables (content format, posting schedule, platforms)

   - Payment terms

   - Hybrid / CPA / CPS structures when applicable

   - Repeat collaboration and long-term partnership options

5. Answer questions, handle objections, and push toward a clear agreement

6. Send a written recap after the meeting (terms agreed + next steps)

7. Follow up until the deal is fully confirmed and ready for execution



You are the company’s face in the meeting. Our team supports you with proposals, background info, and internal approval — but YOU lead the conversation and drive the deal to close.



————————————————————————



What you do NOT need to do



• Find KOL lists from scratch

• Send mass cold
s or cold DMs

• Book meetings (our team schedules them for you)



Your focus is 100% on showing up, negotiating well, and closing.



————————————————————————



Requirements



• Excellent English — very fluent, natural, and confident in live video/voice meetings (required)

• Strong professional presence — well-presented on camera, clear communication, trustworthy image

• Female candidates preferred for this client-facing representative role

• Based in the Philippines, available full-time

• Flexible schedule for meetings across different time zones (including evenings when needed)

• 2+ years experience in BD, account management, KOL/influencer commercial talks, affiliate, crypto, or iGaming

• Experience discussing CPA, CPS, hybrid deals, or repeat KOL partnerships is a strong plus

• Able to take brief notes during calls and write clear follow-up summaries in English

• Stable internet, quiet workspace, professional background for video calls



————————————————————————



Ideal candidate



You are comfortable representing a company in front of KOLs and agents. You can explain an offer clearly, negotiate calmly, and close details without needing someone else on every call. You treat each meeting as a real business negotiation, not a casual chat.



————————————————————————



Hiring process



Step 1 — Application review

We review your CV, photo, and English video intro.



Step 2 — Live mock negotiation (required)

Shortlisted candidates will join a live video call with our team. You will role-play as our company representative in a sample KOL / agent negotiation (e.g. rate discussion, deliverables, CPA/CPS terms). This is to test your English, confidence on camera, and negotiation style.



Step 3 — Paid trial period (required before full offer)

Candidates who pass the mock call will enter a paid trial period (typically 2 weeks).



During the trial you will:

• Join real or simulated KOL meetings scheduled by our team

• Represent the company using our proposals and talking points

• Send post-meeting recaps in English

• Receive feedback after each call



Our management may join some calls to evaluate your performance. Trial compensation will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.



Step 4 — Full-time offer

If the trial goes well, we will extend a long-term full-time offer with base pay plus commission on closed deals.



Salary and full compensation package will be discussed during the interview and before the trial period starts.



————————————————————————



What we offer



• Remote, full-time, long-term role after successful trial

• Performance-based commission on closed deals

• Support from our execution and operations team (KOL info, proposals, meeting schedule)

• Growth path to Senior Partnership Manager for strong performers



————————————————————————



How to apply



Please send:



1. CV / resume

2. Recent professional photo

3. A 2–3 minute English video: introduce yourself + describe one time you represented a company or client in a business meeting or negotiation

4. Your weekly availability for calls (including evening slots if possible)

5. Earliest start date



Only candidates comfortable with a live mock negotiation and a paid trial period should apply.

* Conduct performance reviews.

SYSTEMS, KPI’S & REPORTING

* Ambassador recruitment

* Ambassador activity

* Conversion

*
 performance

* Social media growth

* Content production

* Campaign performance

Our objective is to have one clear system where management can immediately see:



What is happening ? Who owns it ? What is overdue ? What is producing results ? What needs attention next.



REQUIREMENTS



We are looking for someone with:

title: Family Travel Content Manager & Photo/Video Editor / Digital Archivist
description:
Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term Position



We are looking for a talented, creative, highly organized Photo & Video Editor / Digital Archivist / Family Travel Content Manager to help transform a very large professional and family travel photography archive into beautiful photo books, engaging travel content, and commercially valuable digital assets.



This is not simply a social-media posting position. We are looking for someone who loves photography, storytelling, travel, organization, and beautiful design and wants to take long-term ownership of an extensive visual archive.



About the Photography Collection



Our archive contains 250,000+ photographs and videos spanning family life, travel, wildlife, destinations, landmarks, museums, historical sites, and professional photography.



The photographer is an award-winning professional photographer whose work has received recognition in the United States and internationally.



A major goal of this position is to make sure these photographs don’t simply remain stored on hard drives. We want to preserve our family’s memories while also identifying images and video with commercial, editorial, tourism, educational, and stock potential.



Primary Responsibilities



???? Photo Organization & Digital Archiving



Continue organizing and curating an archive of 250,000+ photographs and videos.

Sort photographs by trip, destination, date, subject, event, and other useful categories.

Identify duplicates, poor-quality images, and the strongest photographs.

Maintain a logical and searchable digital archive.

Add appropriate metadata, descriptions, captions, and keywords.

Identify historically or personally significant photographs that should receive priority.

???? Photo & Video Editing



Professionally edit selected photographs.

Color correct, crop, straighten, retouch, and prepare images for their intended use.

Edit travel and family videos.

Create short-form vertical videos/reels from existing footage.

Select the strongest photographs and clips without needing every choice dictated.

Maintain a natural, professional photographic style rather than excessive filters or artificial-looking edits.

???? Weekly Family Photo Books



One of the most important responsibilities is creating at least one completed, print-ready family photo book each week.



Books should be:



Beautifully designed

Fun and visually interesting

Well organized

Embellished appropriately

Written with engaging captions and storytelling

Historically and geographically accurate

Ready to upload/order through Shutterfly or another approved photo-book service

These books will document our children’s lives, family experiences, and extensive travels.



This is a major performance expectation of the position.



???? Travel Content & Storytelling



Help create destination-first travel content using our extensive travels throughout the United States, Canada, and other destinations.



Responsibilities may include:



Creating travel posts and reels

Writing destination-focused captions

Researching locations, wildlife, history, museums, attractions, and landmarks when necessary

Using photographs of signs, exhibits, and informational displays from our travels as source material for accurate storytelling

Creating educational travel content

Developing content that is useful and interesting to other traveling families

Our public travel content should focus primarily on destinations and experiences, while protecting children’s identifying and private information.



???? Photography & Content Monetization



Help develop the archive into an income-producing digital asset.



Potential opportunities include:



Stock photography

Stock video

Editorial licensing

Commercial licensing

Tourism licensing

Educational licensing

Direct image licensing

Prints and wall art

Calendars

Postcards

Books

Digital products

Social-media revenue

Affiliate revenue

Other approved photography/content opportunities

Responsibilities include identifying commercially viable photographs and videos, preparing them appropriately, writing descriptions and keywords, and uploading them to approved platforms.



Who We’re Looking For



The ideal person is:



An excellent photo editor

A capable video editor

A beautiful and creative layout designer

Extremely organized

Detail oriented

A strong English writer

Comfortable researching unfamiliar destinations and subjects

Able to tell a story visually

Interested in travel, wildlife, history, and photography

Able to work independently

Comfortable making creative decisions

Reliable with weekly deliverables

Interested in a long-term position

Experience with Adobe Lightroom, Photoshop, Canva, video-editing software, photo-book design, digital asset management, social media, or stock photography is highly desirable.



You do not need to know every platform already. We value someone who can learn quickly and take ownership.



Schedule



Part-time, remote, flexible, and results-based.



We care more about consistently completed, high-quality work than requiring someone to sit online during a particular schedule.



Because this position involves large files, applicants should have reliable high-speed internet and access to a computer capable of professional photo and video editing.



Compensation



Base compensation: $125 USD per week



Additional opportunities include:



Up to $50/week quality/performance bonus related to completed photo-book work

Revenue share of approximately 10–20% on qualifying revenue generated from approved photography/content monetization activities

Specific revenue-sharing terms will depend on the type of revenue generated.



How to Apply



Please include:



A brief introduction about yourself and why this position interests you.

Examples of your photo editing.

Examples of your video editing.

Examples of photo books, albums, graphic layouts, or similar design work, if available.

Examples of social-media or travel content you’ve created, if available.

The software you use for photo and video editing.

Your internet speed and computer specifications.

Your experience managing large numbers of digital files.

Please also begin your application with the word PUFFIN so we know you carefully read the entire job description.



Finalists



Final candidates may be asked to complete a small paid practical project using sample photographs and/or video.



We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with this position and help turn years of extraordinary photographs, travel experiences, and family memories into something beautiful, organized, useful, and lasting.

title: Static ads maker / translator
description:
We are an Ecommerce company in the health and beauty niche industry (mainly supplements, creams, oils, etc) currently selling only on Meta.

About 70% of our ads are static ads and we are looking forward to finding an experienced static ads maker and translator. 

The salary will be based on your experience and quality of work and can be negotiated. 

We are looking for a top player here so paying over 1000$ is not an issue for us.

BENEFITS:

- Long term role for years to come: we value trust and loyalty

- Salary to be discussed based on efficiency, experience (trackrecord) and performance of statics

The more we are convinced you are the right person, the more you will get paid.

- Flexible hours - 6 days a week  

- Work load between 8-9 hours per day

- Be part of our team :)





RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS (two main tasks):



Generating AI static ads based on our top performing ads and the analysis of our product pages.

You will be given our top ads and different product pages from which you will have to create a tailored version. 

It will be very important to ensure congruency between the static ad and the product page which is the next step where the client will end up.

You will need to be able to demonstrate or prove you have experience from past Ecommerce clients during the application process.



As a secondary task, you will also translate batches of statics in different languages via our translation tool as we run in 10 different countries.



We need someone who pays attention to details and can adjust based on our feedback. Our ideal prospect is also not afraid to ask questions and always double checks his work.



REQUIREMENTS:

- Experience in static ads ideation and generation via AI tools (Nano banana Pro and other tools)

- Available 6 days a week (no other job allowed, you will only work for us)

- You’ll need a second screen to perform properly and fast

- Fast internet connection / backup generator in case of power outage

- Calm and focused environment (crucial)

- Answers promptly and ready to hop on a call during shift hours

- Tech-savvy and can easily navigate Google sheets and Canva

- Detail-oriented and independent (will double check his / her own)

- Emotional intelligence and strong communication / can clearly enunciate any issue encountered or asks questions if needed





VIDEO LOOM APPLICATION:



If you don't send a loom video, your application will not be reviewed.



If you've read this whole job post, send me a message starting with “READY” and answer precisely the next questions after briefly introducing yourself (age, city, marital status, etc) in a short loom video:



1. What is your current situation ? Any imperatives such as family, church, studies, etc.

We expect you to be available 6 days a week as this is a full time role and are looking for someone who will be part of our team only (no other company work allowed).

No need to go into details but we must know what is taking up your time outside of work.

Exemple: “I go to Church every Sunday from 8 to 11am approximately”.

Or “I might need to take care of my relatives on that day” etc.



2. Where do you live exactly and what’s your internet speed ?

We expect you to have a backup solution in case of power outage. 



3. Give us a detailed breakdown of your prior work experience and study curriculum if applicable (both remote and non remote work).

You will also explain why your contract ended for each job.

Example: “I worked for a video editing company from June 2023 to July 2025. During that time, I only worked for that company for which my only task was to edit videos following their guidelines. 

My contract with them stopped as their company stopped operating in July 2025.”

Include all contracts / jobs even if contract were not related to static ads or if contract lasted for a week. 



4. Lastly, open your static ads portfolio or your favorite AI tool you have used with past clients and present some of your best work explaining why you d
 to create those ads in that way and why you think those static ads in particular were winners.

This last part is the most important section of the video and we expect your loom / video to last between 3 and 7/8 minutes.



Please be honest in your answers. We value trust and long term commitment.

Looking forward to have you in the team and develop our relationship :)



Victor
